raw.title: Principal Speech Data Linguist
raw.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
raw.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

As speech and audio models get better, the human role gets harder, not easier — it moves from producing transcripts to defining what a correct one is, adjudicating the cases models still get wrong, and designing the human-in-the-loop workflows that keep improving them. Innodata runs high-volume segmentation and transcription workflows for the customers and frontier labs building these models, and we are hiring a principal-level linguist to own the linguistic standards and quality behind that work — today, and as the workflows evolve alongside the models over the next two years.

This is the applied-expert counterpart to our Speech & Audio Research Scientist. You set the standards the models are trained and measured against, and you understand the big picture: how different transcription and segmentation methods change what a model learns, and how that ripples into the speech and content-understanding systems our partners are building. You know the research and you know the tools — from IPA and acoustic analysis to forced alignment and the ASR engines our partners benchmark against — but your leverage is linguistic judgment and standard-setting at scale, not building models yourself.

What You’ll Own:

  • You will own the linguistic foundation of Innodata's segmentation and transcription work across languages, domains, and use cases. Concretely, you will:
  • Define transcription and segmentation standards, style guides, and annotation conventions — verbatim and clean/intelligent verbatim, IPA and phonetic transcription, timestamping and boundary segmentation, speaker labeling and diarization labels, disfluencies and non-speech events, code-switching, and orthographic conventions.
  • Establish and run the quality frameworks behind that work: rubrics, error taxonomies, adjudication processes, inter-annotator agreement, and human QA at scale.
  • Own the quality lifecycle for transcription and segmentation deliverables end to end — pre-processing and normalization of incoming data, quality checks at the point of acceptance, post-processing and pre-delivery validation against spec, and report creation and packaging for delivery — partnering with delivery operations on execution at scale.
  • Design the human-in-the-loop workflows themselves — deciding where human review, correction, and adjudication add the most value as ASR quality rises, so our experts spend their time on what the models still can't do rather than on what they already can.
  • Handle the linguistically hard cases models fail on — accented and dialectal speech, low-resource and multilingual audio, overlapping speech, domain jargon (medical, legal, technical), and noisy acoustic conditions.
  • Partner with the Speech & Audio Research Scientist to turn model objectives into transcription and segmentation specifications, and to work out how different transcription methods — verbatim versus clean, phonetic versus orthographic, and how audio is segmented and labeled — affect the training and evaluation of ASR, TTS, and speech and content-understanding models.
  • Train, calibrate, and mentor expert transcribers and reviewers, and build the onboarding and calibration that keep quality consistent as the work scales.
  • Represent Innodata's transcription and segmentation approach to the customers and frontier labs we partner with, and contribute to the methodology and best-practice documentation that make our work legible to their teams.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Substantial industry experience (typically 8+ years) in transcription, segmentation, and speech-data quality — enough that you have authored standards, not only followed them. This is a principal-level role, and we weight practical depth heavily.
  • A Bachelor's degree in linguistics, phonetics, or computational linguistics, or a closely related field, is required — with a strong foundation in phonetics, phonology, and sociolinguistics so that IPA, prosody, disfluency, dialect, and register are native concepts. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • A big-picture grasp of how transcription and segmentation choices flow downstream into modeling — how different methods change what speech and content-understanding models learn, and therefore which method fits which modeling objective. You can explain to a model builder why a transcription decision matters.
  • Fluency in phonetic transcription and IPA, plus hands-on experience with acoustic and phonetic analysis of speech — spectrograms, formants, pitch and prosody, and segment boundaries — applied to real, messy speech data at scale (for example in Praat).
  • Deep experience with audio segmentation and its conventions — utterance and turn boundaries, timestamping, and speaker and diarization labeling — across real-world audio.
  • Hands-on fluency with the modern speech stack: Whisper and the commercial ASR engines your partners benchmark against (such as AssemblyAI, Deepgram, Rev, and Speechmatics), forced alignment (for example the Montreal Forced Aligner), and annotation tools such as ELAN.
  • Comfort scripting for speech-data work — Python for batch processing, QA, and metrics such as inter-annotator agreement and WER, plus regular expressions and Praat scripting — enough to work fluently with data and pipelines without needing an engineer for every task.
  • Practical data-management skills across the delivery lifecycle — pre-processing, acceptance-stage quality checks, post-processing, pre-delivery validation, and report creation and packaging — so deliverables leave the door correct, consistent, and well documented.
  • Multilingual capability and hands-on experience with accented, dialectal, and code-switched speech; low-resource languages a strong plus.
  • A point of view on how human-in-the-loop workflows should evolve as models improve — where humans stay in the loop, where they move up to adjudication and standard-setting, and how to measure the difference.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable working directly with research scientists and interfacing with the customers and frontier labs we partner with.
  • Bonus: responsible-AI considerations for speech, such as bias across accents and dialects and privacy and consent in voice data.

The expected salary range for this position is $160,000 - $185,000 p/year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

As a Senior Service Account Manager (SAM), you are the strategic architect of the customer experience for Everpure's most significant enterprise accounts. You will transform the post-sales relationship by serving as a high-impact advocate and trusted advisor, bridging the gap between complex customer needs and Everpure's engineering and product teams. By driving seamless product deployments and operational excellence, you ensure our customers don’t just use our technology—they thrive with it.

  • Advanced Analytical & Strategic Planning: Demonstrated skill in conducting technical risk analyses, capacity planning, and environment assessments to mitigate risks and accelerate a customer’s operational objectives.
  • Project Leadership & Influence: Strong project management background with the ability to coordinate multiple high-priority projects and influence internal stakeholders to deliver results for the customer.

Job title: Sales Orchestrator, Rare Hematology West

About the job


National Sales Orchestrator, Rare Blood Disorders- Rare Hematology

Sanofi Rare Blood Disorders, Commercial Sales Excellence

The National Sales Orchestrator (NSO) is a strategic, customer facing role focused on optimizing processes and prioritizing sales opportunities to “orchestrate” execution and drive revenue growth.

This individual will support commercial sales excellence by identifying and prioritizing sales opportunities using data, digital lead generation tools, and reporting systems to elevate field execution. This specialized role will support sales execution of brand strategy and act as a dedicated liaison between sales, marketing, GTMC and leadership to drive operational effectiveness and enable optimal performance of Rare Blood Disorder products.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:


Identify and Prioritize Business Opportunities

  • Identify and prioritize specific HCA and HCP target list opportunities using data analysis and field insights.
  • Assist with refining target lists and provide insights into the marketing segmentation approach.
  • Conduct field visits to create/refine “One Sanofi” approach with overlapping cross TA accounts.
  • Observe how the field utilizes digital tools and resources and act as a liaison to improve.
  • Optimize how and where we prioritize our field time and where we leverage other digital/virtual channels; support Omnichannel approach.
  • Leverage predictive intelligence to identify trends, opportunities to “harmonize” call activities.
  • Create personalized outreach strategies in coordination with sales and marketing efforts.
  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to provide insights into sales performance.
  • Collaborate with ABMs and V&A to identify/prioritize hospital contracting opportunities.
  • Create a patient funnel model at a territory level that allows for more effective collaboration with cross-functional partners to align resources and maximize impact.

 Data Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Identify and implement improvements to sales processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Act as liaison for the sales team to manage team needs for data and reports.
  • Partner with sales operations on Power BI improvements based on managing system enhancements and tailor our reports to our needs.
  • Provide systems direction or training at territory level to support strategic account and business planning.
  • Support sales team in analyzing their individual territory customer data to be more strategic minded, spot trends, identify opportunities, track progress, and pre-call plan using data.
  • Support brand strategy and provide objective observations, insights, and data to increase impact on patient and customer experience.
  • Optimize the use of One CRM system to ensure data accuracy and streamline output.
  • Create dashboards for measuring our progress at a national, regional, and territory level.

Collaboration & Special Projects

  • Partner with marketing on strategic projects and pilot new initiatives to improve sales performance.
  • Create new opportunities to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of collaboration teams.
  • Improve/Create Cross Functional Key Account Management tools.
  • Lead special projects across the team to address business needs.
  • Leverage AI/analytics for customer insights, resource allocation and tactical recommendations.
  • Partner with marketing to understand digital brand plans and help amplify digital efforts.
  • Partner with operations and the transformation team to embed an Omnichannel mindset for how we approach our customers, content development, key business processes transformation and change management.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 4+ years of pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology, or related life sciences industries sales experience
  • Ability to travel as per business needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Rare Disease, Hematology/Oncology sales experience
  • Proven track record of working cross-functionally on strategic, ambiguous projects.
  • Genuine curiosity to identify new opportunities and ways of working.
  • Creativity to develop innovative approaches and personalized outreach strategies.
  • Analytical Skills and Problem-Solving – Ability to analyze sales data and generate actionable insights. Identify trends, interpret data, and leverage it to solve problems and improve processes.
  • Technical Proficiency- Familiarity through direct experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva One CRM, Compass Power BI) and sales tools.
  • Communication and Collaboration –Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Innovation and Adaptability – Ability to quickly adapt to change and apply a growth mindset to the business.
  • Organization and Time Management –Strong organizational and prioritization skills to manage multiple projects.
  • Customer Centric Approach– Develop and implement strategies that streamline processes and create an optimized customer experience.

Why choose us?


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

Powered by Gen AI advancements, our technology offloads repetitive day-to-day work and frees human analysts to focus on real threats and higher-value projects. We are venture-backed, and our team has a rare blend of deep experience across cybersecurity, AI/ML, and SaaS product development. Join us if you want to be on the ground floor of using Gen AI to transform cyber defense. Learn more at.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the two squads that decide whether Dropzone works on day one of a deployment and whether it keeps working at scale.

The Integrations squad gets every eligible signal source into the AI SOC Team complete, deduplicated, and once, so no alert goes uninvestigated because of a data gap. The Platform squad makes connecting and administering Dropzone something customers do themselves, including tenant management for MSSPs, access control, audit trail, case management, and governed response actions.

These squads share one outcome: the time from contract signature to trusted, self-serve coverage of a customer's full signal estate. Today that number depends too heavily on our sales engineers and support team. Your job is to make it a product number.

This is a senior individual contributor role embedded in product/engineering trios. You own the customer problem, the business outcome, prioritization, and the honest answer to whether we succeeded. You will not be handed a roadmap. You'll help discover the problem, define the right solution, and own whether it lands. You'll report to the Head of Product.

What you'll do

  • Serve as product lead in two cross-functional trios alongside engineering and design, owning the customer problem, business outcome, and prioritization for each squad.
  • Lead continuous discovery with SOC analysts, SOC managers, MSSP operators, and platform administrators. You talk to customers every week, not every quarter.
  • Define and instrument the metrics that tell us, per customer, whether their signal estate is fully covered and whether they got there without our help.
  • Run the integration prioritization process: reconcile requests from sales, POCs, customer success, and production telemetry into a stack-rank that survives contact with a closing deal.
  • Decide which integration categories Dropzone builds, partners for, or declines, and document the reasoning so the company stops re-litigating it.
  • Turn admin, tenant, audit, and access workflows into product that enterprise and MSSP customers configure themselves, with the governance controls regulated buyers require.
  • Own the response action surface with the maturity model we hold ourselves to: recommend, preview, approve, execute, verify, learn. Nothing executes without human-defined authorization and a verifiable trail.
  • Ship in small increments, measure impact, and adjust. Every release carries the problem it solves, the outcome it supports, a metric to watch, and a named validation owner.
  • Contribute to the product operating model: help define what good discovery, prioritization, and release look like at Dropzone.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning platform, integrations, or infrastructure-adjacent product where the customer is technical and the failure modes are quiet.
  • Experience shipping in security, observability, data infrastructure, or an adjacent domain. You can hold your own with a SOC analyst on how an alert moves from an EDR or SIEM into a case.
  • A demonstrated discovery practice. You can describe the last assumption you were wrong about and how you found out before you shipped it.
  • A track record of outcome-based roadmaps: decisions that changed measurable customer behavior, not feature lists that got approved.
  • Comfort being the person who says no to a customer request and can explain why in language the account executive can repeat.
  • Strong written communication. Most of your influence here happens in documents read by people who were not in the meeting.
  • The habit of separating facts from inferences in your own work, and noticing when others do not.
  • A preference for focused ownership over distributed coordination. You do your best work deeply embedded in a problem with a small, accountable team.

Preferred

  • Cybersecurity or security operations domain experience.
  • Experience with MSSP, multi-tenant, or regulated deployment models.
  • Experience at Series A–C stage companies with small, fast-moving product teams.
  • Familiarity with continuous discovery, JTBD, and outcome-oriented product operating models. If Inspired and The Lean Product Playbook describe how you already work, you will feel at home here.
  • Hands-on fluency with data and telemetry tooling, or code-based prototyping.

Work Environment/Travel

We are a 100% remote company where you will work from your home with company-provided equipment to set you up for success. Semi-frequent travel to professional office settings and other events locally and nationally; some overnight travel expected.

Compensation

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range below, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. If you are hired at Dropzone your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition, all compensation packages include significant above market new hire equity grants because we believe in rewarding long term value creation. If you are hired at Dropzone your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical to allow for future and continued salary growth. We also offer a generous benefits package, including company paid health insurance, 401K Plan with employer match, Self-Managed PTO, parental leave, and more.

$175,000—$190,000 USD

Focused on employment and labor law since 1958, Jackson Lewis P.C.’s 1,000+ attorneys located in major cities nationwide consistently identify and respond to new ways workplace law intersects business. The Firm is ranked in the First Tier nationally in the category of Labor and Employment Litigation, as well as in both Employment Law and Labor Law on behalf of Management, in the U.S. News - Best Lawyers® “Best Law Firms”.

Job Summary

The Practice Innovation Attorney will play a pivotal role in advancing the firm’s broader innovation objectives by identifying high-value opportunities to improve legal work, translating practice needs into practical technology- and GenAI-enabled solutions, and leading the adoption of new solutions by attorneys and legal professionals. The role will help shape how emerging technologies are evaluated, developed, and incorporated into legal practice in ways that are practical, scalable, responsible, and aligned with firm priorities.

Reporting to the Manager of AI and Innovation, the Practice Innovation Attorney will advise and collaborate with practice group leadership, attorneys, knowledge management professionals, IT, legal engineers, and external vendors to identify opportunities, define requirements, develop and validate solutions, and drive adoption across the firm. The role requires a strong understanding of legal practice, particularly litigation with a preferred focus on Labor & Employment, demonstrated familiarity with legal AI and GenAI tools (e.g., Harvey, Westlaw AI, Lexis+ AI, CoCounsel, or similar platforms), and the ability to translate complex technology capabilities into practical applications for legal professionals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Practice Discovery and Use-Case Strategy

  • Engage practice leaders, attorneys, and business professionals to identify recurring challenges, inefficiencies, and opportunities for innovation and AI-enabled improvement.
  • Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on practice value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment with firm priorities.
  • Map current and future-state legal workflows and define practical requirements for selected solutions.
  • Develop recommendations for how GenAI and other emerging technologies can improve legal workflows, client service, and the delivery of legal services.

Solution Design and Validation

  • Translate legal and business requirements into clear use cases, workflows, and functional requirements.
  • Partner with legal engineers, knowledge management, IT, and vendors to develop, test, and refine solutions.
  • Design and conduct legal workflow testing, including output review, issue identification, and documentation of appropriate use and limitations.
  • Help develop safeguards, guidance, and escalation paths for responsible use of AI and other emerging technologies.

Adoption and Practice Engagement

  • Lead adoption efforts for assigned tools and use cases, including demonstrations, targeted training, coaching, communications, and workflow integration.
  • Collaborate with HR Learning and Professional Development teams to integrate innovation and AI initiatives into onboarding, attorney development, and ongoing learning programs.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to practice leaders and knowledge management on the responsible and effective use of firm-approved AI and GenAI tools.
  • Develop practical playbooks, prompt guidance, examples, and quick-reference resources to facilitate effective use and adoption.
  • Establish feedback channels and use adoption and user feedback data to improve solutions, workflows, and user experience.

Market Awareness and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor legal AI capabilities, developments in professional responsibility guidance, and relevant changes in legal service delivery.
  • Assess new platform features and recommend whether and how they should be introduced into firm workflows.
  • Share lessons learned and reusable approaches through the Innovation Center of Excellence and other appropriate firm forums.
  • Identify emerging opportunities and advise firm leadership on trends, capabilities, and potential applications that advance firmwide innovation objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.
  • Minimum of 5 years of legal practice experience or equivalent experience in legal technology, legal operations, or legal innovation roles.
  • Demonstrated experience with legal AI and GenAI platforms (e.g., Harvey, Westlaw AI, Lexis+ AI, CoCounsel, or similar tools).
  • Strong understanding of legal workflows, litigation processes, and how emerging technologies can be applied to common legal tasks.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, develop practical recommendations, and lead cross-functional initiatives from concept through adoption.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to advise and influence diverse audiences and translate complex technical concepts into practical guidance.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments and practice groups, with strong judgment and project leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in labor and employment law or litigation practice.
  • Experience with change management or technology adoption initiatives in a law firm or professional services environment.
  • Familiarity with eDiscovery platforms, document management systems, and legal research databases.
  • Prior experience working with legal innovation or practice technology teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technology, process improvement, or AI adoption initiatives.

Competencies & Skills

  • Innovation & Strategic Thinking: Ability to identify high-value opportunities, assess emerging capabilities, and connect technology initiatives to firmwide priorities and legal practice needs.
  • Legal Technology & GenAI Fluency: Deep familiarity with the legal AI ecosystem and an understanding of how GenAI and other technologies can be integrated into legal workflows and practice management systems.
  • Solution Design & Execution: Ability to translate practice needs into clear use cases, requirements, workflows, and practical solutions, and to drive initiatives through validation and adoption.
  • Advisory & Influence: Trusted advisor who can engage senior stakeholders, communicate recommendations clearly, and build alignment across practice groups and business functions.
  • Communication & Presentation: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technology concepts in plain language and effectively demonstrate tools and use cases to legal professionals.
  • Judgment & Risk Awareness: Strong judgment regarding responsible AI use, legal ethics, information governance, and appropriate safeguards and escalation paths.
  • Collaboration & Relationship Building: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with attorneys, IT, leadership, legal engineers, and vendors to achieve strategic goals.

Reporting Structure & Work Arrangement

This position reports under the AI and Innovation Group. The Practice Innovation Attorney will work closely with practice group leaders, knowledge management attorneys, IT, legal engineers, and firm leadership on a day-to-day basis.

This role may require occasional travel to firm offices for in-person demonstrations, targeted training, or other innovation initiatives and is eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement in accordance with firm policy.

About Us:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

About the Role The Database Engineering team owns the data infrastructure behind CorroHealth's Utilization Management (UM) and Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI) lines of business. That includes the ETL pipelines, integrations and databases that every downstream analytics product depends on. As a Database Engineer, you'll build and support mission-critical pipelines processing data on sometimes rapid frequencies. You'll work with operations and clinical stakeholders to turn business needs into reliable, well-documented data solutions. You'll report to the Director of Database Development & Operations and join a small team of experienced engineers.

This is remote position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

Sadly, we are on high alert for scams, imposters and application fraud.

We employ comprehensive screening and verification methods. Any attempt at application fraud or misrepresentation will be identified and lead to immediate removal from consideration.


Permanent Work Status Required (USC or GC)


Employees must reside and work within the continental U.S.

This is a remote position.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines: design, build and support data pipelines using T-SQL stored procedures, PowerShell and Python, orchestrated through JAMS and SQL Agent.
  • Work on integrations: develop and support bidirectional Salesforce ↔ SQL Server sync (Relational Junction, DBAmp) and secure file-based integrations (SFTP / GoAnywhere MFT) with clients and partners.
  • Design databases: create and evolve schemas, views, stored procedures and indexing strategies that scale with the business.
  • Tune performance: diagnose and fix slow queries and jobs using execution plans, Query Store, wait statistics and index analysis.
  • Ensure data quality: build validation and reconciliation checks so data stays accurate from source to report. Investigate and resolve discrepancies when they come up.
  • Build reporting: develop and maintain SSRS reports and Power BI datasets that support operations and decision-making.
  • Protect PHI: build solutions that meet HIPAA requirements, including least-privilege access, secure transfer and auditability.
  • Support production: monitor scheduled jobs, troubleshoot failures and drive root-cause fixes. Take part in on-call rotation for after-hours monitoring of critical jobs.
  • Follow engineering practices: use source control (Azure DevOps Git repositories), take part in code review, and follow change-management processes for production deployments.
  • Document your work: write and maintain technical documentation and runbooks, and help capture undocumented process knowledge.
  • Collaborate: work with operations leaders, analysts and clinical teams to clarify requirements and explain technical tradeoffs in plain language.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of hands-on T-SQL development on Microsoft SQL Server
  • Strong command of stored procedures, query tuning, indexing and data modeling
  • Experience building and supporting production ETL processes, including scheduling, error handling and restartability
  • Scripting experience in PowerShell and/or Python for automation and integration
  • Experience working with healthcare data and an understanding of HIPAA obligations for PHI
  • Experience with SSRS and/or Power BI
  • Comfort with source control and working in a code-review culture
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Utilization management, clinical review, CDI, claims, denials or appeals data
  • Salesforce data integration (DBAmp, Relational Junction or similar)
  • JAMS or another enterprise job scheduler
  • Azure data services
  • Managed file transfer (GoAnywhere or similar)

How You Work

  • You chase a data discrepancy until you find its root cause, not just its symptom.
  • You can explain a pipeline failure to a non-technical operations lead and agree with them on next steps.
  • You document as you build, because you know someone else will support it at 2 a.m.
  • You manage competing priorities across several stakeholders without letting production quality slip.

We Offer

  • Quality of life with a remote predictable, full-time schedule
  • Competitive Salary commensurate to experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision coverage and more
  • Long-term disability insurance, and life insurance
  • Ample parental leave
  • 401K with company match
  • Certification and Tuition Reimbursement
  • Holidays, Flexible Time Off

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. raw.excerpt: About SparkfundSparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid.
raw.description:
About Sparkfund

Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. Through its Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) model, Sparkfund enables utilities, energy majors, and large-load customers to deploy front-of-the-meter batteries and gensets as distribution infrastructure. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on-time, on-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost.

With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. To learn more about Sparkfund, visit sparkfund.com.

FINANCE ANALYST

Department: Finance

Reports To: Director, Corporate Finance

Location: Remote (United States); preference for candidates in the New York City metro area or elsewhere on the East Coast
Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt
Travel: Occasional; company gatherings and team meetings

About the Role

Sparkfund prices and structures its Distributed Capacity Procurement deals using a set of programmatic pricing models, and this role is responsible for both sides of that work: building the ad hoc project finance models a deal needs when it falls outside the existing templates, and keeping the standing programmatic models accurate as cost, revenue, timing, and financing assumptions shift. You'll work from our existing model library, but you'll also be expected to build new models from scratch when a deal structure calls for something the templates don't cover.

The work sits between Finance and the teams closest to the deals. You will partner with Business Development, Program, and Project teams to source the assumptions that feed a model, test them against the underlying data, and flag anything that doesn't hold up before it reaches a pricing output. You will also translate model output into language deal teams can use when they negotiate. You will report to the Director of Corporate Finance. Success in this role looks like a maintained set of pricing models that are accurate and able tohold up under review from Finance leadership and deal counterparts.

How We Work at Sparkfund

Our values guide how we work together, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and partners. Regardless of role or level, we expect everyone at Sparkfund to demonstrate:

  • Excellence: We hold ourselves to a high standard, take pride in the quality of our work, and continuously look for ways to improve.
  • Stewardship: We take ownership of our work and make thoughtful decisions with the long-term interests of Sparkfund, our customers, our partners, and one another in mind.
  • Positivity: We bring a constructive, solutions-oriented mindset to our work and contribute to an environment where people can collaborate, learn, and do their best work.

These values are part of how we evaluate success at Sparkfund, alongside the skills, competencies, and results required for each role.

What You'll Do

Pricing and Financial Modeling

  • Build, audit, and maintain the programmatic pricing models used to structure and price deals across Sparkfund's DCP programs
  • Update and refine existing models as program economics, deal structures, or market conditions change
  • Build bespoke financial models for one-off pricing structures or deal structures that fall outside existing templates

Cross-Functional Assumption Validation

  • Partner with Business Development, Program, and Project teams to source the cost, revenue, timing, and financing assumptions that feed pricing models
  • Validate assumptions against underlying source data and flag discrepancies before they reach a pricing output
  • Translate model outputs into terms non-finance stakeholders can use to structure and negotiate deals

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in financial modeling, corporate finance, or a related quantitative role
  • Strong technical modeling skills, including building, auditing, and troubleshooting complex Excel models from scratch
  • Working knowledge of DCF analysis, capital stack construction (debt, equity, mezzanine), and discount rate and cost of capital concepts, with fluency in IRR, NPV, and other return metrics used to evaluate deal economics
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort validating assumptions across multiple sources
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate model output for people who don't work in finance
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with project finance structures or energy asset modeling
  • Experience in infrastructure, energy, or utility-facing businesses
  • Experience building models that support live deal negotiations

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Analytical rigor: You build models and analyses that hold up under review. You check your work before you share it and you catch inconsistencies in the data underneath.
  • Assumption validation: You are comfortable going to other teams for the inputs you need, pressure-testing what you get back, and raising a discrepancy before it lands in a pricing output.
  • Communication clarity: You can walk someone outside Finance through what a model says and what it means for a decision they need to make.
  • Reliability: You deliver recurring work on time and raise a risk to a deadline early rather than at the deadline.

Compensation

The expected base pay range for this role is $81,000–$125,000 per year. This range reflects the span of base pay across the geographic markets where Sparkfund hires for this role, and the range applicable to a given candidate will depend on where they are located. For candidates based in New York City, the expected base pay range is $101,000–$125,000 per year.

Individual placement within the range depends on work location, prior experience, technical capabilities, core competencies, positional scope, internal alignment, and other relevant business factors.

Where applicable, this position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Any such compensation is separate from base salary and is not guaranteed. Eligibility, amounts, and payment are subject to applicable plan terms, company performance, individual performance, and other business considerations.

Benefits

Sparkfund offers a competitive benefits package designed to support employees both at work and outside of it, including:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
  • 401(k) with 2% employer match
  • Flexible vacation policy with a strong emphasis on work-life balance
  • Federal holidays and Flexible Fridays, including half-day Fridays each week
  • 12 weeks of gender-neutral paid caregiver leave
  • One-time work-from-home stipend for eligible remote roles
  • $100 monthly phone and Wi-Fi allowance

Work Environment

Sparkfund is a remote-first company with a distributed workforce and emerging hub offices in Denver, Minneapolis, and Washington, DC. This role is performed remotely with occasional travel for team meetings, company gatherings, and other business needs. We are open to candidates anywhere in the United States where Sparkfund is registered to employ, with a preference for candidates in the New York City metro area or elsewhere on the East Coast for time zone overlap with the Finance and deal teams.

No significant physical requirements apply beyond standard office work. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Sparkfund is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Sparkfund also provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs or practices, in all phases of the hiring process and throughout employment. If you need an accommodation, please let us know.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties, responsibilities, and requirements may change at any time based on business needs.We encourage individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply — even if you do not meet every listed qualification — as skills and competencies can develop in different ways.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Senior Integrated Content Strategist, B2B owns the integrated content strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B accounts and sets the strategic direction and execution of deliverables. This role operates across the full integrated content ecosystem: thought leadership, sales enablement, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks — all engineered to move a considered, multi-stakeholder buyer through a long B2B sales cycle. Senior Strategists build and defend content roadmaps directly with C-level stakeholders, translating pipeline and revenue goals into a clear content thesis that internal teams and client executives can rally behind. This is a strategist who thinks in systems: mapping content audits to the buyer journey, running audience research and stakeholder interviews to surface what actually moves a B2B deal forward, and adapting the roadmap as account performance and market signals shift. They bring product-level thinking to the content offering itself; proposing new formats and approaches before clients ask. They will also mentor and uplevel the strategists and writers who support their accounts. They are equally fluent identifying the single biggest content opportunity in a client's funnel and articulating why it matters in a room full of VPs and CMOs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end integrated content strategy and execution across thought leadership articles, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks for a portfolio of B2B accounts
  • Lead content audits mapped to the B2B buyer journey, using audience research, market analysis, and direct stakeholder and customer interviews to identify where content is and isn't driving pipeline
  • Set the strategic direction for each account's content roadmap, aligning every deliverable to client revenue and pipeline goals rather than treating content as a standalone output
  • Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem to benefit your department's objectives
  • Ensure timely delivery of all Integrated Content workflows, maintaining 100% adherence to Power Digital's processes (Asana, Slack, Pulse)
  • Proactively surface strategic insights and business-critical updates to both internal and client teams, positioning yourself as the point of authority on the account's content direction
  • Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy
  • Lead cross-functional content initiatives, coordinating with Paid Media, SEO/AEO, Creative, and Sales teams to ensure content strategy operates as the connective tissue across channels
  • Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
  • Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
  • Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
  • Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
  • Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
  • On time for all deliverables & launches
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a B2B Integrated Content Marketing role with direct client-facing experience, ideally supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • A journalism or copywriting foundation is strongly preferred. This discipline underpins credible strategic recommendations and gives this person authority when writing or reviewing high-stakes B2B content
  • Advanced understanding of data analysis and data visualization utilizing tools such as (but not limited to): HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Figma, or Unbounce
  • Advanced, fluent proficiency with AI tools as a core part of the strategic workflow, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — used for research, ideation, drafting, and content operations at scale
  • Advanced knowledge of B2B Integrated Content strategy spanning thought leadership, lead magnets, sales enablement material, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, brand website copy, sales and conversion-focused landing pages, and brand messaging, with a focus on aligning every deliverable to business goals and revenue priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
  • Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers

raw.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
raw.excerpt: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country.
raw.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Team: People
Reports to: Head of People
Location: Remote (US)
Type: Full-time
Compensation: $150,000 - $175,000

Why This Role, Now

CodePath's hiring has outgrown the setup that got us here. Our next challenge is reimagining the hiring engine so it reliably turns our growth into great hires: a clear bar at every stage, enough qualified candidates in every pipeline, and a team equipped to move quickly without lowering the standard.

This is a net-new leadership role. You will own the talent acquisition function end to end, lead the team that runs it, and partner directly with our senior leaders on the hires that shape the company. You will report to the Head of People and sit at the center of how CodePath grows.

What You Will Own

This role runs at scale. CodePath is hiring across every function at once, engineering, product, growth, curriculum, delivery, and revenue, alongside seasonal instructor hiring and fellowship surge hiring that arrives fast and cannot miss. You will own two outcomes that have to hold together: time to hire, kept to a predictable and competitive window so we do not lose the people we want, and quality of hire, held to a bar that does not drop when the pressure is on. Everything below serves those two outcomes.

Own the hiring system. You will own the process end to end: the rubrics, the interview stages, the scorecards, the paid work sample every CodePath hire completes, and the gates that decide who advances. You will own the operating cadence that keeps searches on clock and the recruiting stack and metrics that run underneath it, pipeline health, conversion, time to offer, and source performance, and you will use them to decide where to invest. You will make sure every stage produces real signal, so that decisions are trustworthy, and you will keep hardening how we evaluate as AI changes what a strong candidate looks like.

Scale pipeline and throughput. You will drive the volume and quality of candidates across every search, from individual contributors to executive and program-launch surge hiring. The goal is straightforward and measurable: every search reaches a strong slate of finalists, sourced and inbound work together, our pipelines reflect the communities CodePath serves, and no role stalls for lack of qualified candidates.

Own the employer brand and candidate experience. You will own how CodePath shows up to candidates who are also evaluating us. On a mission-driven, nonprofit compensation model, the sell is trajectory, craft, and impact rather than top-of-market cash, and it has to carry through every touchpoint from first outreach to offer. You will make that experience a reason strong people choose CodePath.

Lead and grow the talent team. You will manage a team of recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators across full-time and contract roles. You will set the operating rhythm, coach the team, decide where to add capacity, and build a staffing model that matches the hiring load rather than reacting to it.

Partner with the Head of People and leadership. You will turn company goals into a hiring plan, working with the Head of People and senior leaders on org design, leveling, and where headcount should go against what the organization can absorb. You will set talent priorities across competing searches, keep leadership honest about whether we are on track to build the teams the mission needs, and bring a point of view rather than a status report.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

In your first 90 days, you will learn our funnel from application to offer, meet every hiring manager, and diagnose where signal and volume break down today.

By six months, you will have a hiring process where each stage carries a defined purpose and a clear bar, interviewers are trained and accountable for a specific signal, and hiring managers engage on a predictable cadence.

By the end of your first year, open roles consistently reach strong finalist slates, time to hire is under control because the process produces good decisions rather than fast ones, and CodePath has a talent function that scales with the organization instead of straining against it.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in talent acquisition, including several years leading a recruiting team through a period of significant growth.
  • You have built or rebuilt a hiring process, not just run one. You can point to specific changes you made to rubrics, interview design, or gating, and the outcomes they produced.
  • You lead with data. You know your funnel math, you can name your conversion rates by stage, and you use them to decide where to invest.
  • You hold a high bar on quality and can defend it under pressure to move faster. You understand that compressing a process that is not yet producing good signal only leads to worse decisions sooner.
  • You are a strong people manager. You coach recruiters to raise their game, and you build teams that own their work.
  • You partner well with executives and hiring managers. You can push back with respect, hold the line on process, and keep senior stakeholders aligned.
  • You use AI as a genuine multiplier for the mechanical parts of recruiting, and you have a clear view of where human judgment should stay in the loop.

Requirements

  • Experience hiring across technical and non-technical functions at once (engineering, product, growth, operations).
  • Fluency with Greenhouse, Gem, and LinkedIn Recruiter (standard recruiting stack).
  • Experience in a high-growth startup.
  • A track record of building always-on talent pools and an employer brand that draws candidates in.

How We Work

We recruit AI-first. AI clears the busywork so that human judgment on candidates gets more attention, not less. We expect you to adopt and improve these tools, and to have a view on where they help and where they do not belong. We value people who pick up new tools on their own because they want to work better, not because someone told them to.

Why Join

You will take a function that got CodePath this far and reimagine it for a much larger scale, with the mandate and the executive support to do it right. Your work will directly determine the caliber of people who carry CodePath's mission forward, which means it will determine how many students reach a career in tech that would otherwise be out of reach.

Compensation

CodePath standardizes salaries by level, no matter where you live. Salary within this band is determined by the relevant experience and skills you demonstrate through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position, work from anywhere in the U.S. CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 to Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings
Pay range
$150,000—$175,000 USD

raw.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

As an Account Executive at Coalescence, you will play a key role in driving sales growth and client acquisition for our professional services supporting SaaS solutions, with a focus on Salesforce. You will work closely with prospects and clients to identify and provide tailored solutions, helping them achieve their business objectives. You will also collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless handover to the client services team.
This position is ideal for someone with strong interpersonal skills, experience in building relationships at the C-level, and a solid understanding of professional services within the SaaS ecosystem.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify, engage, and close new business opportunities, meeting or exceeding assigned sales quotas.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with C-level prospects and customers, acting as a trusted advisor.
  • Manage the full sales cycle—from lead generation through contract negotiation—ensuring smooth transition to the client services team.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within new clients to maximize customer value and increase company revenue.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align client needs with Coalescence's services, ensuring seamless project delivery.
  • Drive revenue through an assigned quota, divided into quarterly targets.
  • Work closely with the Go-to-Market Leadership and Sales team to contribute to sales strategies and internal growth initiatives.
  • Fulfill Management by Objectives (MBOs) set by leadership.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in sales roles, preferably in a company selling professional services supporting a SaaS solution.
  • Experience working with services based technology products.
  • Proven track record of success in foundational sales activities, including high-volume outbound prospecting (cold-calling, email, social selling), expert-level qualification of leads using frameworks like BANT/MEDDIC, and consistent achievement of meeting/pipeline generation targets.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to clearly convey value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience selling IT services and/or products in a start-up environment.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce products and Professional Services Automation products. Familiarity with sales methodologies such as ValueSelling.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple client engagements and internal initiatives.
  • Eagerness to work closely with leadership, sales, and delivery teams to ensure the highest level of client satisfaction.
  • Ability to creatively navigate client challenges and deliver solutions that support long-term business relationships.
Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The employee may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Coalescence Cloud is a premier data and analytics Systems Integration partner to Salesforce and Certina. We are dedicated to streamlining and enhancing our customers’ journey to process automation, focusing on delivering the outcomes they desire.
We harmonize data across that entire customer journey—from opportunity to renewal—leveraging our expert delivery teams to provide cutting-edge advice and solutions.
Our team believes that data is the bedrock of power business technologies—from consulting on an appropriate tech-stack to implementation and managed services, we are committed to client-centric guidance that emphasizes revenue growth, cost savings, and risk mitigation.
At Coalescence Cloud, we operate with the values of Guidance, Collaboration, Excellence, Sustainability, and Innovation. These principles guide our interactions with clients, partners, and teams—ensuring every interaction is supported by integrity and commitment.
BENEFITS
Medical, Vision, Dental, and Life insurance plans
Company HSA Contribution
PTO and Holiday: 12 PTO days, 6 sick leave days, and 11 Paid Holidays
Inclusive Maternity and Paternity leave policies
Role related bonuses
One-time Certification Bonuses
401k Management
WellHub Membership
Additional benefits provided through our HRIS platform

As required by applicable law, a reasonable pay range has been provided for this position. Actual compensation may vary outside of the listed range based on individual qualifications and business considerations. Salary ranges are subject to change at any time.
In addition to base pay, Coalescence Cloud offers a comprehensive total rewards package that may include health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, performance incentives, and other benefits and perks designed to support employee well-being and work-life balance.

raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation’s leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

Why Join Us

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You’ll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. You matter.

If you’re energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.

What you’ll be doing:

The Virtual Psychologist conducts individual and group therapy (adults, children and adolescents) on topics such as mood, anxiety, stress and eating disorders; conducts family therapy and/or family education sessions; develops each patient’s individualized treatment plan; and works with interdisciplinary treatment team to implement the plan. All sessions are conducted within a HIPAA compliant telehealth platform, following established protocols. This position is remote.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Conducts individual psychotherapy, group therapy and family therapy
  • For each patient on case load, complete clinical paperwork and administrative tasks including:
    • Treatment plans
    • Individual and Family Therapy progress notes and group notes
    • Aftercare plan
    • Discharge summary
    • Regular communication with patient's outpatient community provider(s)
  • Conducts comprehensive assessments and treatment planning for each patient on case load:
    • Completes psychosocial, self-harm, pain and suicide assessments
    • Creates individualized treatment plans with specific and measurable goals in collaboration with treatment team members
    • Creates therapeutic treatment agreements or behavioral support plans as needed
    • Holds therapeutic team meeting with patient to address any concerns, if needed
  • Attends treatment team meetings and treatment team rounds to coordinate patient care with interdisciplinary team
  • May provide training and guidance to less experienced teammates

Must haves:

  • Doctorate of Psychology (PsyD) or Doctorate of Philosophy (PhD) in Psychology from an APA Accredited program
  • Currently a licensed Psychologist residing in a Psychology Interjurisdictional Compact (PsyPact) State
  • Passed Examination for Professional Practice in Psychology (EPPP)
  • Minimum 2-4 years' experience conducting psychotherapy
  • Ability to move from one group assignment, line of service, and/or ages served to the next with ease – flexibility
  • Collaborative nature, strong communication - multi-disciplinary team
  • Engaging and skilled in navigating video interactions
  • Familiarity with or ability to easily and quickly learn required technology including a video meeting platform, EMHR, and other computer programs

This range is dependent upon candidate's state of residence, experience and market expectations.

Virtual Pay Range
$90,000—$130,000 USD

What We Offer

At ERC Pathlight, caring for people is our mission and that begins with caring for our own team. Your well-being matters, and our benefit program is designed to support every part of your life.

We offer competitive compensation; comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; generous Paid Time Off; Parental Leave benefits; Retirement benefits; and tuition reimbursement to help you continue growing in your career.

We also recognize that mental health is part of every person’s experience. That’s why we strive to create a workplace where you feel supported, seen, and encouraged—personally, professionally, and at home.

When you thrive, you can do your best work. And your best work changes lives.

raw.excerpt: Who We Are:We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Senior Integrated Content Strategist, B2B owns the integrated content strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B accounts and sets the strategic direction and execution of deliverables. This role operates across the full integrated content ecosystem: thought leadership, sales enablement, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks — all engineered to move a considered, multi-stakeholder buyer through a long B2B sales cycle. Senior Strategists build and defend content roadmaps directly with C-level stakeholders, translating pipeline and revenue goals into a clear content thesis that internal teams and client executives can rally behind. This is a strategist who thinks in systems: mapping content audits to the buyer journey, running audience research and stakeholder interviews to surface what actually moves a B2B deal forward, and adapting the roadmap as account performance and market signals shift. They bring product-level thinking to the content offering itself; proposing new formats and approaches before clients ask. They will also mentor and uplevel the strategists and writers who support their accounts. They are equally fluent identifying the single biggest content opportunity in a client's funnel and articulating why it matters in a room full of VPs and CMOs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end integrated content strategy and execution across thought leadership articles, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks for a portfolio of B2B accounts
  • Lead content audits mapped to the B2B buyer journey, using audience research, market analysis, and direct stakeholder and customer interviews to identify where content is and isn't driving pipeline
  • Set the strategic direction for each account's content roadmap, aligning every deliverable to client revenue and pipeline goals rather than treating content as a standalone output
  • Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem to benefit your department's objectives
  • Ensure timely delivery of all Integrated Content workflows, maintaining 100% adherence to Power Digital's processes (Asana, Slack, Pulse)
  • Proactively surface strategic insights and business-critical updates to both internal and client teams, positioning yourself as the point of authority on the account's content direction
  • Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy
  • Lead cross-functional content initiatives, coordinating with Paid Media, SEO/AEO, Creative, and Sales teams to ensure content strategy operates as the connective tissue across channels
  • Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
  • Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
  • Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
  • Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
  • Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
  • On time for all deliverables & launches
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a B2B Integrated Content Marketing role with direct client-facing experience, ideally supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • A journalism or copywriting foundation is strongly preferred. This discipline underpins credible strategic recommendations and gives this person authority when writing or reviewing high-stakes B2B content
  • Advanced understanding of data analysis and data visualization utilizing tools such as (but not limited to): HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Figma, or Unbounce
  • Advanced, fluent proficiency with AI tools as a core part of the strategic workflow, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — used for research, ideation, drafting, and content operations at scale
  • Advanced knowledge of B2B Integrated Content strategy spanning thought leadership, lead magnets, sales enablement material, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, brand website copy, sales and conversion-focused landing pages, and brand messaging, with a focus on aligning every deliverable to business goals and revenue priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
  • Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers
  • Proactive, solution-oriented problem solver with a team-player mentality and a bias toward original thinking over templated execution
  • Exceptional presentation skills, with proven ability to present integrated content strategy and sales pitch presentations directly to C-suite executives, tailoring storytelling for the room and delivering actionable, defensible recommendations under executive scrutiny
  • Forward-thinking, product-level perspective on the content offering itself; someone who proposes new formats, services, and approaches rather than only refining what already exists

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Book Revenue per Employee: $30k
  • Client Retention: 90%
  • Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 90%
  • Range of the number of accounts (8-12)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Manage accounts with the highest workflow volume or complexity with positive feedback → primarily working on Enterprise and/or Growth accounts
  • Deep literacy of the full B2B marketing funnel and buyer journey, and command of the role Integrated Content plays in moving multi-stakeholder deals through it
  • Identifies the biggest Integrated Content opportunities based on client goals and pipeline priorities, and delivers a clear, defensible strategic roadmap for execution
  • Working with the team to delegate Integrated Content tasks and receive them back with enough time to review so that you are always hitting deadlines in regards to client workflow with minimal errors (no typos, grammatical issues). Strong attention to detail with minimal review from Account Managers and Account Directors.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
