raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Investor Relations serves as the company's primary liaison to the investment community and a strategic advisor to the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors on investor sentiment, market perceptions, valuation drivers, and capital markets trends. This leader owns the company’s investor relations strategy and external investment narrative, translating technology roadmap , software and platform capabilities, business strategy, and financial performance into a compelling investment thesis that strengthens investor confidence and supports long-term shareholder value creation.

The Senior Director builds and maintains relationships with investors, analysts, rating agencies, and other key stakeholders, while bringing external market intelligence and investor perspectives back into the organization to inform enterprise decision-making. The role partners closely with Finance, Strategy, Legal, Communications, and business leaders to ensure clear, consistent, credible, and transparent communication with the investment community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the company's investor relations strategy, ensuring the investment community has a clear understanding of the company's strategy, performance, growth opportunities, transformation priorities, and long-term value creation objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors on investor sentiment, shareholder expectations, ownership trends, valuation drivers, capital allocation perspectives, market dynamics, and emerging risks and opportunities.
  • Develop and continually evolve the company’s investment thesis and external financial narrative, translating complex technology, product architecture, software and cloud business models, and technical differentiation into clear value drivers for tech-focused investors and analysts. Ensure consistency and compelling articulation of the company’s strategy, competitive differentiation, financial performance, and long-term value proposition across investor-facing communications.
  • Develop and execute a proactive investor targeting and engagement strategy, building strong relationships with existing and prospective technology and software sector portfolio managers, tech-specialist equity analysts, sell-side analysts, rating agencies, and broader capital markets stakeholders to strengthen the company’s credibility, visibility, and long-term shareholder base.
  • Gather, analyze, and synthesize market intelligence, including investor feedback, analyst perspectives and models, peer and competitive performance, valuation trends, shareholder composition, and broader capital markets developments; translate insights into actionable recommendations for executive leadership and the Board.
  • Lead the company’s investor-facing communications and engagement, including quarterly earnings materials and calls, investor presentations, Analyst Days, conferences, roadshows, shareholder outreach, annual meeting support, and other high-profile investor interactions.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Communications, Strategy, and business leaders to ensure accurate, transparent, consistent, and compliant investor communications and public disclosures, including earnings materials, SEC filings, annual reports, proxy materials, and other shareholder communications.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically adept System Analyst / Solution Designer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation for our core DomOs applications and services.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Product Designers, and Software Engineers to design, document, and deliver robust features that support complex international use cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business & Functional Analysis: Understand business and technical requirements; validate proposed solutions against existing system functionality across a wide range of international use cases.

  • System Subject Matter Expertise: Master the DomOs application architecture, services, and integrations to engage effectively in both high-level business conversations and deep-technical team discussions.

  • Solution Architecture & Documentation: Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications. Collaborate with Solution Architects to create and maintain domain models, solution models, API specifications, sequence diagrams, and event models.

  • Feature Delivery & Hand-Off: Lead hand-off sessions to walk development teams through technical specs. Provide ongoing functional guidance throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

  • UX & Product Collaboration: Partner with Product Designers to ensure solutions deliver a superior user experience within DomOs applications.

  • Acceptance Testing & Diagnostics: Perform acceptance testing on completed features. Help troubleshoot data, application, and service issues using log files.

  • Data & Configuration Analysis: Analyze existing store configurations and data (e.g., pricing, coupons, addresses, reports) to collaborate on system migration tools and approaches.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or Computer/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering.

  • Experience: 3+ years of applicable IT experience working on large-scale application initiatives.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills. Adept at breaking down complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and conversing technically with engineers.

  • APIs & Data: Working knowledge of RESTful API concepts and strong hands-on experience working with JSON files.

  • Diagnostics: Proven ability to troubleshoot and diagnose application issues independently by reviewing log files.

  • Technical Fundamentals: Working knowledge of database concepts, operating systems, and at least one programming language.

  • Environment: Experience working alongside web-based application development teams.

  • Nice to Have:

    • Development, APIs & Data: Programming experience in C#, hands-on familiarity with APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman), and solid technical knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

    • Systems, Architecture & Logging: Hands-on experience with Unix/Linux operating systems, system modeling frameworks (UML), and log management tools such as Splunk.

    • Methodology: Practical experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment.

We offer a hybrid work environment. Most US-based positions can alsobeperformed remotely (any exceptions will be noted in the Minimum Qualifications below.)

Our Mission:

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity.

Who We Are:

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

Summary:

With data such as a billion+ historical job postings, tens of millions of active job seekers interacting with our system, and hundreds of billions of impression and click events, there are incredible opportunities to use your skills to build new data-driven features. Working at ZipRecruiter, you will be helping literally millions of people find their dream job. We’re working on problems like: given a training set of job postings, and known salaries, build a system that predicts salary for novel jobs.Of course, you know that while building models is fun, it's also just one step in the process; gathering training data, cleansing it, digging into it, extracting features from it, etc, is a huge part of the job

Key Focuses:

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex business problems
  • Lead complex machine learning projects that solve business challenges and add value to the broader ZipRecruiter Business
  • Design the overall architecture and infrastructure for machine learning systems, ensuring scalability, efficiency, and robustness
  • Push the boundaries of what's possible in machine learning in your organization, finding new and innovative ways to use AI to drive business value
  • Provide leadership and set tone for Machine Learning Engineers at ZipRecruiter leveraging industry best practices and innovation
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in machine learning and AI, and drive adoption of new techniques and technologies as appropriate

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 7+ year of professional software development experience with a deep focus in machine learning
  • Comprehensive knowledge and experience of machine learning algorithms, techniques, and best practices
  • Extensive experience in machine learning model design, data pipeline design, experimentation and validation design, system design, and/or architecture design.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ year of professional software development experience with an expertise in machine learning
  • BS/MS/PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, related technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • Expert knowledge of machine learning algorithms (e.g., linear regression, SVM, decision trees, neural networks, clustering, etc.) and best practices
  • Profound knowledge of machine learning algorithms and frameworks, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn
  • Extensive background of deep learning architectures and techniques, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
  • Deeply versed in NLP techniques and tools, such as tokenization, stemming, lemmatization, sentiment analysis, and named entity recognition, and libraries like NLTK, SpaCy, or BERT

As part of our team you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $180,000-$225,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges.   • *This position operates 8:30a.m.- 5p.m. PST**

BASIC PURPOSE:

The Business Administration Specialist III is responsible for providing senior-level support for administrative duties within the onboarding, compliance, billing, and payroll functions of the organization. This role plays a crucial part in ensuring the efficient operation of these functions, contributing to the overall satisfaction of both clients and employees.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

1. Billing:

  • Generate accurate invoices for clients based on agreed-upon billing terms and contracts.
  • Verify timesheets and expense reports submitted by temporary employees for accuracy.
  • Address billing discrepancies promptly, collaborating with internal teams and clients to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Assist with the preparation and processing of weekly and monthly invoices, including updates to billing contact information.

2. Payroll:

  • Process payroll for temporary employees, ensuring timely and accurate payments.
  • Maintain payroll records and documentation, addressing inquiries from employees and resolving issues as needed.
  • Perform data entry for late timesheets and service logs, create payroll reports, and reconcile timesheet discrepancies.
  • Follow up on missing timesheets and maintain accurate timesheet records.

3. Communication and Collaboration:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients, employees, and internal teams to facilitate effective communication.
  • Collaborate with recruiters and account managers to align client needs with staffing solutions.
  • Provide support and guidance to employees on administrative matters, fostering positive relationships.

4. Administrative Duties:

  • Prepare and maintain various reports, including monthly CSS reports and oversight visit reports.
  • Update employee files and monitor payroll and invoice inboxes.
  • Process personnel changes, including direct deposits and compliance metrics tracking.
  • Train and audit the work of subordinate Business Administration Specialist.
  • Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1 year of lead experience within CCE or 2 years in HR, credentialing, or payroll/billing administration in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong understanding of employment laws and regulations to ensure compliance in administrative tasks.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and relevant payroll/billing software; experience with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Forms).
  • Meticulous with paperwork and data entry, ensuring accuracy in onboarding, compliance, billing, and payroll processes.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for professional interaction with clients, employees, and internal teams.
  • Collaborative mindset to work with recruiters and account managers, fostering a cohesive work environment.
  • Ability to handle highly confidential information responsibly.

Education:

High School diploma or equivalent required; degree in business administration, or a related field preferred. Or any equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.

Benefits

Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition Assistance, and Pet Insurance. The company offers a variety of Wellness options through Burnalong, which offers a robust online platform of classes and programs as well as local gym access.

raw.description:
Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)

Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week |$6/hour
performance-based increase after 6 months

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.

This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead, identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

  • Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong executive presence and professional communication style

  • Must be a Mac OS user

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

  • Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

  • Device Requirement: Mac OS required

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

raw.description:
Utilization Management Nurse

Work from home within Oregon, Washington, Idaho or Utah

Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside in Idaho and Utah


Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For:


Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Nurses are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Clinical Services team, our Utilization Management Nurses provide utilization management (such as prospective concurrent and retrospective review) to best meet the member’s specific healthcare needs and to promote quality and cost-effective outcomes and appropriate payment for services – all in service of making our members’ health journeys easier.


Are you a Nurse who has a passion for healthcare? Are you a Nurse who is ready to take your career to the next level and make a real difference in the lives of our members? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

What You Bring to Cambia:

Qualifications:


  • Associate or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field
  • 3 years of case management, utilization management, disease management, auditing or retrospective review experience
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Must have licensure or certification, in a state or territory of the United States, in a health or human services discipline that allows the professional to conduct an assessment independently as permitted within the scope of practice for the discipline (e.g. medical vs. behavioral health) and at least 3 years (or full time equivalent) of direct clinical care.
  • May need to have licensure in all four states served by Cambia: Idaho, Oregon, Utah, Washington.
  • Must have at least one of the following: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a health or human services-related field (psychiatric RN or Masters’ degree in Behavioral Health preferred for behavioral health); or Registered nurse (RN) license (must have a current unrestricted RN license for medical care management)

Skills and Attributes:


  • Knowledge of health insurance industry trends, technology and contractual arrangements.
  • General computer skills (including use of Microsoft Office, Outlook, internet search). Familiarity with health care documentation systems.
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to interpret policies and procedures and communicate complex topics effectively.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage workload independently.
  • Ability to think critically and make decisions within individual role and responsibility.

What You Will Do at Cambia:


  • Conducts utilization management reviews (prospective, concurrent, and retrospective) to ensure medical necessity and compliance with policy and standards of care.
  • Applies clinical expertise and evidence-based criteria to make determinations and consults with physician advisors as needed.
  • Collaborates with interdisciplinary teams, case management, and other departments to facilitate transitions of care and resolve issues.
  • Serves as a resource to internal and external customers, providing accurate and timely responses to inquiries.
  • Identifies opportunities for improvement and participates in quality improvement efforts.
  • Maintains accurate and consistent documentation and prioritizes assignments to meet performance standards and corporate goals.
  • Protects confidentiality of sensitive documents and issues while communicating professionally with members, providers, and regulatory organizations.

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.


  • Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho: The expected hiring range is $36.80 – $49.80 an hour, the full salary range is $34.20 – $55.70 an hour and the bonus target is 8%.
  • North Dakota: The expected hiring range is $35.21 - $47.63 an hour and the full salary range is $31.86 - $50.98 an hour.

About Cambia


Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.


Why Join the Cambia Team?


At Cambia, you can:

  • Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
  • Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
  • Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
  • Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
  • Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.


In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:


  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
  • Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
  • Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
  • Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
  • Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
  • Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
  • Commute and parking benefits.

Learn more about our benefits.


We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.


As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please email . Information about how Cambia Health Solutions collects, uses, and discloses information is available in our Privacy Policy.

Careers with real impact.

Every role at Orsini moves a patient closer to life-changing therapy. We partner with biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to make access simple, compassionate, and reliable - so no patient is left behind. Make your next role matter.

ABOUT ORSINI

Providing compassionate care since 1987, Orsini is a leader in rare disease and gene therapy pharmacy solutions, built to simplify how patients connect to advanced medicines. Through our comprehensive commercialization solutions including a nationwide specialty pharmacy, patient services hub, home infusion and nursing network, and third-party logistics provider, we work with biopharma, providers, and payors to ensure No Patient is Left Behind™

OUR MISSION

Orsini is on a mission to be the essential partner for biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to support patients and their families in accessing revolutionary treatments for rare diseases. Through our integrated portfolio of services, we seek to pioneer comprehensive solutions that simplify how patients connect to advanced therapies while providing holistic, compassionate care so that No Patient is Left Behind™.

CORE VALUES

At the heart of our company culture, the Orsini LIVE IT Core Values serve as guiding principles that shape how we interact with each other and those we serve. These values are the driving force behind our commitment to excellence, collaboration, and genuine care in every aspect of our work.

COMPENSATION & LOCATION

The compensation for this role is $28 per hour. This is a remote position; however, preference will be given to candidates located near one of our office locations in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, or Columbus, Ohio.

Compensation for candidates hired in other geographic locations will be reviewed and determined during the hiring process.

POSITION SUMMARY:

This role will include Benefits Verification, Billing, and Collections of Manufacturer specific programs. Will be the point of contact of daily communication of issue resolution on designated accounts. Assist with problem solving any issues with high dollar A/R accounts, assist in back-up for our Gene Therapy Operations Manager and collaboration of best practices for manufacturer project management

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:
  • Effectively work on the billing and collections of designated manufacturer programs to maximize collection and minimize write-offs.
  • Responsible for benefits verification and prior authorization process.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve escalated AR and manufacturer issues/concerns.
  • Ability to be flexible and assist with other projects when needed.
  • Responsible for being the designated point person for daily tasks and communication to manufacturers.
  • Meet manufacturer needs for drug products serviced in therapy team
  • Collaborate with other functional areas to ensure quality service delivery.
  • Interact with outside customers in a professional manner.
  • Reach out to sites to schedule meetings and/or site visits as well as inform them when we have new products.
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & TRAINING
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in patient accounts, benefit verification and/or collections with specialty pharmacy experience
  • Familiar with Account Receivable (AR) and operational health care systems.
  • Experience with Microsoft applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Familiar with the authorization process, appeal process and other processes/procedures integral to AR collection efforts.
  • Experience with billing and foundation assistance application procedures.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills; ability to multi-task and change priorities quickly; detail oriented
  • Able to problem solve and assist coworkers through the thought process of solving problems.
  • Collaborate on best practices for efficiency and streamlines communication throughout teams.
  • Experience making outbound calls to inform facilities of new products and to set up meetings.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being:

  • Medical Coverage, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Accident and Critical Illness coverage
  • Company-paid life insurance options
  • Generous PTO, paid holidays, and floating holidays

It is our policy to ensure that both current and prospective employees are afforded equal employment opportunity without consideration of race, religious creed, color, national origin, nationality, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, or present or past disability (unless the nature and extent of the disability precludes performance of the essential functions of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation) in accordance with local, state and federal laws.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex programs into clear, employee‑friendly language.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop insights to support decision‑making.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization skills, and comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with sound judgment and the ability to navigate sensitive conversations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with HRIS and compensation tools preferred.

We offer a competitive, globally aligned benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work-life balance. raw.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Who we are

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As Principal Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will be the most senior individual contributor on a team of about fifteen engineers, setting the technical direction for the product and leading its largest, most consequential projects from idea to customer.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will shape that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a technical leadership role, not a management role. You will work directly with engineering and product leaders to form the roadmap, then lead engineers across sub-teams to execute it. You will stay hands-on: you write and review code every week, and the hardest problems land on your desk first.

What the team owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

  • Set the technical direction for Chainguard Containers: the architecture of the build pipeline, the registry, and the adoption tooling over the next one to three years, written down and defended in the open.
  • Form the roadmap with engineering and product leaders, then execute it. Turn ambiguous business goals into sequenced, staffed technical plans, and own the delivery of the largest multi-team projects from concept through production and adoption.
  • Make and own the trade-offs that shape the product: build versus buy, when to re-platform and when not to, what to cut to hit a date. Write the decision down and bring dissenting engineers along.
  • Lead through other engineers. Set the design bar, review the designs and code that matter most, and grow the Staff and Senior engineers around you into the next generation of technical leaders.
  • Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and set the standard for how the whole team uses them safely as volume grows.
  • Follow a problem wherever it goes: another team's service, a customer escalation, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, and work across team and company boundaries to get ahead of planning cycles.
  • Represent Chainguard in the container and open source ecosystem: upstream work, standards conversations, talks, and the customer conversations where credibility is the product.
  • Keep the systems you own healthy: observability, on-call, and the structural fixes that stop whole classes of incidents.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, including several years as the technical lead of large, multi-team projects at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.
  • Closely relevant experience in what we do: container images, container registries and the OCI image format (Open Container Initiative, the standard for container images and registries), Linux distributions or package management, build systems, or software supply chain security.
  • Known in the field. Your work is visible outside your employer: open source you maintain, standards you helped shape, talks or writing that other engineers cite, or systems the industry knows you built.
  • A track record of technical leadership without authority: you have set direction for a team you did not manage, and the team delivered.
  • Experience forming and executing roadmaps with engineering and product leaders, including saying no, re-sequencing, and holding a date.
  • Judgment on trade-offs at the product level. You have made calls that moved a company's roadmap, and you can show what you gave up and why.
  • A systems thinker who designs for the whole path, from upstream source through build, signing, distribution, and the customer's runtime, and who sees second-order effects before they land.
  • High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you unblock others.
  • AI-native in how you build and lead. You use agentic coding tools daily and you have changed how a team works because of them.
  • Architectural depth in Go: you can design a Go service from scratch, plus strong API design, databases and caching, and cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS.
  • Low ego. You do what you say and say what you do, and you communicate early when the news is bad.
  • Excellent written English and experience leading on a distributed, remote-first team.

Nice to haves

  • Deep software supply chain security background: SBOMs (software bill of materials), Sigstore signing, or SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for build integrity).
  • Maintainer of, or significant contributor to, Chainguard's open-source tools (Wolfi, apko, melange) or neighboring projects such as containerd, Kubernetes, or OCI specifications.
  • Experience taking a product from early customers to broad adoption.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.
  • A non-traditional path into engineering. We value people who learned by building.

Location

Remote. United States preferred; Open to Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.

Explore Our Work

Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.

  • Chainguard Academy
Base Salary Range
$229,000—$258,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

Who we are.

Solo.io is reimagining infrastructure for cloud and AI. We unite secure, seamless cloud connectivity with AI-ready, agentic infrastructure, and leading enterprises worldwide trust us to securely connect their applications, services, and AI workloads across any environment.

Joining Solo means working at the center of how enterprises adopt AI: on open source projects built in the open with a global community, alongside the people who created them, for customers who are among the largest in the world. If you want to help organizations accelerate innovation, scale intelligently, and put modern AI agents to work, we’d love to meet you. Learn more at www.solo.io.

About the role.

The Director, Solutions Engineering is a player-coach leadership role responsible for winning the technical evaluation in every deal across our Central and West regions. You will lead a team of Solutions Engineers directly, partnering with regional sales leadership to turn open source adoption of Istio, kgateway, agentgateway and kagent into enterprise customers. You will manage and develop the team, build the repeatable processes that make them consistent, and stay hands-on enough to lead architecture sessions and POCs on our most complex opportunities yourself. Our buyers are platform engineering, security and architecture teams at some of the largest companies in the world, and our deals are won on technical credibility.

Job Description:

  • Lead and develop a team of Solutions Engineers across the Central and West regions, setting a high technical bar and coaching on discovery, demos, POC strategy, and executive communication.
  • Act as technical executive sponsor on the region’s largest and most complex opportunities, leading architecture sessions, design reviews, and objection handling yourself when the deal requires it.
  • Own the technical win in region: decide which deals to go deep on and which to qualify out, and set clear POC success criteria with customers before work begins.
  • Partner with regional sales leadership on account strategy, SE coverage, deal reviews, and forecast accuracy.
  • Build repeatable assets such as discovery frameworks, reference architectures, demo environments, and POC playbooks.
  • Position Solo against open source DIY, hyperscaler offerings, and other agnetic infrastructure, API gateway, and service mesh vendors in competitive evaluations.
  • Act as the voice of the field, bringing structured customer and competitive feedback to the product management, engineering, and marketing teams.
  • Represent Solo in the community through customer workshops, meetups, industry events, and technical content creation.

Job Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in technical pre-sales (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Field Engineer) for infrastructure software, including 3+ years directly managing SEs.
  • Proven record of hiring and developing SEs and measurably improving technical win rate or POC conversion.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in cloud-native technologies, including Kubernetes, agentic infrastructure, service mesh (such as Istio), and API gateways (such as Envoy), along with L4/L7 networking, mTLS, and zero-trust security.
  • Experience selling to enterprise platform engineering, infrastructure, and security teams on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Experience in an open source or open-core sales motion, converting community users into enterprise customers.
  • Fluency in a formal sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar) and the ability to coach a team to use it.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both principal engineers and executive buyers.
  • Located in the Central or West US, with willingness to travel to customers and events in region.
  • Experience with Gateway API, Cilium/eBPF, or another API gateway or service mesh product is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM workloads or agent infrastructure (model gateways, MCP/A2A, agent access governance) is a plus.
  • Background at a CNCF-ecosystem or open-core infrastructure company, or experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, telco), is a plus.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What you'll love about Solo.

At Solo, our culture is all about hiring great people, creating a fun and fast-paced work culture, and letting our teams work with our customers to successfully solve their challenges.

Solo works collaboratively with our customers, partners and open source communities to deliver technology innovation, technology solutions, architectural best-practices, and hands-on education. Solo uses a unique engagement model with our customers that allows us to quickly make them successful, and continue to work closely with them as their production environments grow.

raw.description:
Turn conversations into contracts—and help open new markets for a growing SaaS business.

Our client is looking for a commercially driven Account Executive who enjoys the challenge of building something from the ground up: finding the right prospects, starting meaningful conversations, creating opportunities, and turning qualified leads into new business.

This is a hands-on hunter role for someone who is comfortable with outbound sales and wants real ownership across the early-to-mid stages of the sales cycle.

Why This Opportunity Matters

You won't simply be managing an existing book of accounts.

You'll be responsible for creating the pipeline that fuels growth across your assigned region. From researching target companies and identifying decision-makers to conducting discovery calls, presenting solutions, negotiating, and closing, you'll have a direct role in winning new clients.

Our client's solutions are delivered primarily through annual subscription products, giving organizations access to proprietary data, intelligence, and insights, with consulting services available where relevant.

You'll also work alongside dedicated Client Operations teams that handle proposal support, onboarding, and renewals—allowing you to stay focused on what you do best: prospecting, progressing opportunities, and winning new business.

About Our Client

Our client operates in the SaaS and information services space, providing subscription-based access to proprietary data, intelligence, and insights, alongside a smaller consulting offering.

The commercial team works across markets and territories, combining sales, marketing, subject-matter expertise, and client operations to bring solutions to new customers and expand the company's reach.

As part of the sales team, you'll have exposure to international markets and the opportunity to contribute to the development of new territories.

What You'll Own

In this role, you'll take ownership of the activities that turn a target market into a qualified sales pipeline.

You'll:

  • Research target accounts, identify relevant decision-makers, and build targeted prospect lists.
  • Generate new business through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking events, and referrals.
  • Qualify prospects and develop early-stage opportunities into meaningful sales conversations.
  • Conduct discovery calls and meetings to understand client challenges and connect them with relevant solutions.
  • Present and demonstrate products and services to key decision-makers.
  • Manage your pipeline in Salesforce, keeping opportunity stages, values, probabilities, and sales activity accurately updated.
  • Take ownership of selected opportunities from initial contact through contract signature.
  • Negotiate with prospects and work toward consistently achieving monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
  • Partner with Marketing on campaigns and lead-generation initiatives.
  • Prepare detailed briefs for the Deals Desk covering client objectives, requirements, stakeholders, budget considerations, and deadlines.
  • Coordinate with internal subject-matter experts when specialist product, data, or consulting input is required.
  • Ensure newly signed clients are handed over smoothly to the Client Operations team.
  • Share market feedback and competitive intelligence with leadership.
  • Contribute to quarterly and annual sales plans and help identify opportunities for new territories.
  • Represent the company at relevant regional and national events.
  • Maintain a professional presence on LinkedIn and other relevant social platforms to engage prospects and strengthen brand awareness.

You'll Thrive in This Role If...

You're a B2B sales professional with 2–4 years of experience who genuinely enjoys the hunt.

You don't wait for leads to arrive—you know how to research a market, find the right people, start conversations from cold, and consistently follow up until an opportunity either progresses or is qualified out.

You'll be especially successful if you have:

  • Experience in B2B sales, business development, lead generation, or a similar commercial role.
  • A proven ability to develop opportunities from cold or early-stage prospects.
  • Experience selling SaaS, data, intelligence, research, information services, or subscription-based solutions.
  • Strong communication skills across telephone, email, virtual meetings, and face-to-face conversations.
  • The ability to conduct effective discovery conversations and communicate value to decision-makers.
  • Strong research, presentation, and written communication skills.
  • Good organization and the discipline to manage multiple prospects and follow-ups.
  • Experience working with a CRM; Salesforce experience is a plus.
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Most importantly, you'll bring a proactive and commercially minded approach, with the persistence and curiosity required to build relationships and create opportunities where they don't already exist.

What You'll Get to Build

This role gives you the opportunity to develop your experience across the full new-business sales journey—from account research and outbound prospecting through discovery, solution presentation, negotiation, and closing.

You'll work closely with senior leadership, Marketing, the Deals Desk, subject-matter experts, and Client Operations, giving you exposure to different parts of an international commercial organization.

You'll also have the opportunity to contribute to new-territory expansion, making this a role where your pipeline-building efforts can extend beyond individual deals and contribute to broader market growth.

Location: United Arab Emirates
Work Arrangement: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time
Role: Account Executive

If you're energized by outbound sales, enjoy opening doors that weren't previously open, and want a role where your ability to create and close opportunities directly matters, this could be your next move.

Apply now to take the next step in your B2B SaaS sales career.

Requirements

What You'll Do

Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Research target accounts and identify decision-makers
  • Generate leads through cold calling, email, LinkedIn outreach, and networking
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline in Salesforce with accurate deal forecasting

Qualification & Discovery

  • Conduct discovery calls to understand prospect pain points
  • Qualify opportunities based on fit, budget, authority, and timeline
  • Ask smart questions before you pitch (consultative approach)

Sales Execution

  • Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations
  • Handle objections and negotiate commercial terms
  • Close deals and meet monthly/quarterly revenue targets

Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Marketing on lead generation campaigns
  • Work with our Deals Desk on proposal development
  • Provide market feedback and competitive intelligence to leadership
  • Hand off signed clients to Client Operations with complete information

Market Presence

  • Represent the company at regional events
  • Maintain a professional LinkedIn presence to build personal brand
  • Contribute to pipeline development and territorial expansion

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 2-4 years in B2B sales, business development, or lead generation
  • Demonstrated success prospecting and developing deals from cold leads
  • Track record of quota attainment

Skills & Competencies

  • Comfort with phone, email, virtual meetings, and in-person engagement
  • Strong research and presentation abilities
  • Proficiency with CRM (Salesforce experience is a plus)
  • Excellent written communication—you'll be emailing lawyers, accountants, and C-level prospects
  • Ability to manage multiple prospects and follow-ups effectively
  • Self-directed and comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

Nice to Have

  • Experience in SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Background in data, intelligence, or information services
  • Healthcare industry exposure
  • Additional language skills (Arabic preferred)

About You

  • You think like an owner—you don't just execute, you optimize
  • You're analytically minded about your pipeline and forecast
  • Rejection doesn't discourage you; it's data
  • You prefer commission-based compensation because you want to be rewarded for results
  • You're intellectually honest about what's working and what isn't

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary
  • Remote role with full autonomy over your schedule and territory
  • Real territory ownership—this is your market to build
  • Professional growth—top performers move into team leadership or expanded markets
  • Stable company—profitable, no VC panic, sustainable growth
  • Smart leadership—your VP came up in sales and understands this work
  • Collaborative team—you're not competing with other AEs for leads

Interested?

Apply Now!

raw.description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We're looking for a Senior Business Analyst to lead strategy and discovery work end-to-end across complex client engagements. This role is ideal for an experienced analyst and strategist who can independently own the full arc of an engagement — from framing the problem through delivering a clear, actionable plan — while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.

In this role, you will work as the lead analyst on a cross-functional team, driving discovery, shaping recommendations, and facilitating high-impact client sessions that turn ambiguity into direction. You'll collaborate closely with strategists, designers, engineers, and delivery leads, and bring the experience and judgment to navigate complexity, competing priorities, and high-stakes decisions with confidence.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Lead AI and digital strategy engagements end-to-end, from opportunity discovery and problem framing through prioritization, roadmap creation, and pilot planning
  • Map customer journeys, operational workflows, and decision points to identify where automation, AI, and digital solutions create measurable business lift
  • Build and present compelling business cases that quantify value, define KPIs, and align executive and operational stakeholders on what success looks like
  • Produce lightweight prototypes, agent demonstrations, and proof-of-concept experiences that make strategy tangible and testable for clients
  • Partner with client SMEs to encode institutional knowledge into AI-ready assets including prompt libraries, evaluation examples, and retrieval corpora
  • Define practical governance frameworks aligned to the client's risk posture covering responsible AI principles, privacy, human-in-the-loop controls, and escalation paths
  • Shrink feedback loops by testing ideas early with real users and operational teams, iterating based on evidence rather than assumptions
  • Translate between business and technical teams, ensuring strategy connects cleanly to delivery across design, data, engineering, and change management
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and Figma AI — and agentic frameworks where relevant — to move faster than traditional consulting cycles

Collaboration & Communication

  • Independently lead high-impact client sessions including executive briefings, ideation workshops, and process redesign sprints that move groups from ambiguity to a shared plan
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, serving as a reliable, consultative partner throughout the engagement
  • Communicate complex findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead prioritization and scoping decisions by balancing business value, feasibility, risk, and delivery timelines
  • Frame every engagement in terms of outcomes and impact, pushing back on solution-first thinking where needed
  • Begin mentoring junior analysts, sharing knowledge and supporting their growth in craft and client skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, product strategy, or a related role
  • Deep understanding of AI concepts including LLMs, RAG, copilots, agents, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI principles
  • Demonstrated ability to lead discovery and strategy end-to-end including stakeholder interviews, journey mapping, opportunity sizing, prioritization, and roadmap creation
  • Experience creating executive-ready narratives and aligning senior stakeholders across business and IT
  • Strong applied experience with AI tools for strategy, prototyping, and productivity (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI)
  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, agent workflows, and lightweight AI prototyping
  • Experience independently facilitating workshops and working sessions that move groups to clarity quickly
  • Practical understanding of what it takes to move from pilot to scale including data readiness, change management, adoption, and governance
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, AWS Strands)
  • Experience in a consulting or client-facing environment is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

Acxiom is seeking a talented Product Manager who will be exceptional at delivering data products for data-centric businesses globally. The ideal candidate will have previous success in managing data products, experience engaging with data engineering and analytics/data science teams to produce commercial offerings, comfortable working collaboratively across teams and help us define our data culture. You will understand technology capabilities and how they apply to our strategic roadmap from both a product and customer perspective.



Directs product strategy and execution for Acxiom’s Data & Identity Layer from conception through end of life. Functions as a central resource across product, design, engineering, architecture, quality, marketing, and delivery as the product(s) move through their lifecycle. Partners closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to execute product development plans and ensure product performance meets defined goals.



Operates as an independent product owner within a defined scope, contributing to broader product strategy while owning day-to-day product decisions, delivery, and performance.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Fully functional and self-directed within defined product scope
  • Provides guidance and informal mentorship to less experienced associates
  • Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for a single product, sub-product, or defined capability acting as the Product level first line of response to stakeholders.
  • Collect and prioritize market and stakeholder requirements, turning them into actionable product enhancements and plans.
  • Defines and executes product roadmap aligned to broader product or domain strategy
  • Builds and maintains product business plans to support revenue, adoption, and cost efficiency goals
  • Owns and manages roadmaps, product backlog, including user stories, requirements, and prioritization
  • Establishes and manages quarterly OKRs and product KPIs (e.g., revenue, adoption, availability, quality, cost efficiency)
  • Executes product development plans in partnership with engineering and cross-functional teams
  • Collaborates with Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to support product launches, positioning, and adoption
  • Monitors product performance and drives continuous improvement based on financial, operational, and client satisfaction metrics
  • Works closely with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle
  • Supports research and analysis to inform product enhancements, positioning, and competitive differentiation
  • Escalates complex cross-product dependencies, strategic tradeoffs, and investment-related considerations to senior product leadership

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position does not have direct reports but may mentor less experienced associates in the role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of product management or related experience,
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  • Background in product development, data products, or related technical environments
  • Practical knowledge of product management methodologies and best practices
  • Domain familiarity in marketing data, data products, or other information-intensive product environments
  • The position is not eligible for any sort of sponsorship

Preferred

  • Experience managing large scale implementation of data sets including - data ingestion, integration, transformation and reporting tools experience.
  • Strong technical abilities with an ability to get in the weeds, where necessary. Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, SQL, Python, etc.
  • Advanced, proven knowledge of Acxiom products
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Practical experience in AdTech/MarTech or data-driven product ecosystems
  • Interest in or experience with AI Concepts (Examples: MCP servers, APIs, Agent prompt crafting)

Travel %

  • Up to 25%

Homebased - Conway, Arkansas

raw.description:
User Experience Designer Job Type: Full-time

Position Summary Penn Foster Group is looking for a User Experience Designer to help create intuitive, engaging, and accessible digital learning experiences. In this role, you’ll work across the full UX design process—from understanding user needs and translating research into insights to designing and refining solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, UX researchers, educators, curriculum designers, and developers to create experiences that support learner success and align with technical and business goals. You’ll also use user feedback, research findings, and analytics to continuously improve the learning experience. What You’ll Do

  • Apply design and systems thinking to define problems, develop hypotheses, synthesize research, and identify experience principles that guide design decisions.
  • Help plan and facilitate workshops, co-creation sessions, and collaborative activities that support ideation, alignment, and shared understanding.
  • Communicate design concepts through sketches, wireframes, prototypes, and presentations.
  • Gather and incorporate feedback from users, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to improve solutions.
  • Partner with engineering to develop design specifications, assess feasibility, support sprint planning, and perform design quality reviews.
  • Help execute and evolve a cohesive UX vision across multiple channels and products, ensuring experiences are consistent, scalable, and user-centered.
  • Stay current with UX tools, methods, technologies, trends, and best practices.
  • Adapt to changing project requirements and organizational priorities while maintaining a strong focus on user needs.

What You Bring

  • Experience applying user-centered design principles to create intuitive, engaging, and accessible digital experiences for diverse audiences.
  • Familiarity with research and data-driven design, including analyzing user or learner feedback and using insights to inform design decisions.
  • Understanding of learning management systems, content management systems, structured content, and core technology concepts such as APIs, databases, and dynamic systems.
  • Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • A strong foundation in color, typography, layout, composition, prototyping, and scalable design systems.
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex design concepts clearly.
  • Experience documenting interaction designs, including user flows, states, and edge cases, and supporting accurate implementation by engineering teams.
  • A collaborative, curious, and adaptable approach to problem-solving.

Additional Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in design or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A portfolio demonstrating applied experience in modern UX and digital product design.
  • One to two years of experience in digital product design and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience creating prototypes and using research or data to inform design decisions and iterations.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process

  • U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role.
  • Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, and similar activities. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by bringing together Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable learners to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market. Equal Employment Opportunity We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building diverse teams – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in. What We Offer We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, and free access to our online programs.
