Are you an experienced full service Project Manager in the field of clinical trials who’s engaged in addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology. Are you passionate about impacting the health and lives of patients around the world? Do you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in trial operational delivery?

Precision for Medicine are looking to hire a Clinical Project Manager / Senior Clinical Project Manager with experience in Oncology who have managed full service clinical trials within a CRO setting to join our global team.

In this pivotal role you will have full service oversight for clinical projects across global/regional (ph I-IV) trials, within Oncology. Accountable for clinical project delivery, oversight of all functional departments, and ensuring agreed timelines, scope, cost and quality.

Involved in all study stages, including proposal strategy, development, costing, and bid defence, and seeing studies through the full cycle to completion, managing the client relationship, project team and budget and timelines throughout.

You will work in a cross-functional team with both internal and external stakeholders, driving quality and coordinating the study team.

We offer an amazing high-energy, dedicated, collaborative team members who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments. If you are no stranger to taking charge and seek positive teamwork to deliver extraordinary work, we have an opportunity for you.

How we will keep you busy and support your growth:

  • You will independently lead clinical projects in accordance with the study budget and scope of work. You will use your strong interpersonal and organizational skills to set and achieve objectives in the execution of the projects; both contracted objectives and financial objectives. You may be called upon to run international trials as well.
  • Serve as the primary point-of-contact liaison with the client to provide excellent customer service, including participation in proposal activities and client presentations
  • Liaise with Project Team and senior management of both Precision and sponsors, including C level
  • Handle and lead all aspects of a clinical research trial or trials
  • Total project management for all functional areas including data management, safety, clinical, medical monitoring and biostatistics, etc.
  • Prepare project status updates for clients and management; identifying key deliverables and performance metrics of success and escalation.
  • Serve as an active member of the Project Team with the goal to contribute towards efficient management and execution of trials
  • Prepare and reviews protocols and other study documentation such as project plans, inform consents, site contracts and budgets

Requirements:

  • Degree or similar related life science qualification, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Previous experience in a full service/global Project Management role working in the CRO industry is essential.
  • Extensive experience working within Clinical Operations position within a CRO, and at least 4 years full service Project Management experience in a clinical trial setting working for a Clinical Research Organisation.
    • Experience managing studies within Oncology
    • Working understanding of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process
  • Ability to drive and availability for domestic and international travel including overnight stays
  • Be able to communicate effectively in the English language both written and spoken
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven computer skills (MS Office, MS Project, PowerPoint) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS)
  • Proven ability to develop positive working relationships with individual and teams internally and externally
  • Demonstrated core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities as it relates to the execution of a clinical development plan

Precision for Medicine's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical authorities, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology.

We are a people focussed CRO with a supportive and collaborative environment which promotes work life balance and encourages team development.

We invite you to learn more about our growing organization serving our clients that are researching ground-breaking cancer therapies. We strive to ensure employees feel appreciated for the contributions they make every single day.

Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.

Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at .

At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***

Roofr is growing our Onboarding team, and we're looking for a Spanish-speaking Onboarding Manager (contract) to own the most important window in a customer's journey: the moment they sign to the moment they're live, confident, and getting real value from Roofr.

We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products. Many of them run established roofing businesses but are new to technology, which means the way you show up matters as much as what you know. This role is built for someone who thrives in high-volume environments, believes great onboarding creates the conditions for everything that comes after, and finds real satisfaction in watching a customer go from uncertain to capable.

Your goal is simple: help customers feel the difference Roofr makes in their business as quickly as possible, and make sure getting there doesn't feel overwhelming. We pay attention to two things to know we're on track: how much of what a customer set out to use in Roofr they're actually working with day-to-day, and whether they'd say the onboarding experience genuinely helped them. Those signals tell us where customers are thriving and where we can do better. They're our compass.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full onboarding journey for net-new Roofr customers, from supporting them through Account Setup and training through to a clean handoff to their Customer Success Manager.
  • Manage multiple concurrent onboardings in a high-volume environment, balancing dedicated 1:1 sessions with scalable, group-based training.
  • Guide customers through Roofr in a way that’s practical, confidence-building, and tailored to their unique business workflows, goals, and level of technical experience.
  • Drive customers to a clear graduation milestone: they're live, self-sufficient, and ready for handoff to their Customer Success Manager..
  • Work closely with the Account Setup Team as an onboarding consultant, ensuring Roofr is configured to reflect each customer's real needs and lay the foundation for strong adoption.
  • Deliver engaging live training sessions and group webinars that drive real adoption, not just familiarity.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Retention, Product, and the Customer Success team to surface friction, close gaps, and ensure every handoff is clean.
  • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of Roofr's onboarding playbook, building something that scales, not just something that works today.
  • Act as a trusted guide during a high-stakes window, helping customers prioritize, build good habits, and set themselves up for long-term success in Roofr.

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Fluent in Spanish (written and spoken)
  • 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or enablement within an SMB, B2B, or SaaS environment
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills across live calls, video meetings, email, and webinars
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and adapt your approach based on customer goals, maturity, and engagement level
  • Proven ability to manage customer needs while making thoughtful, outcome-driven recommendations
  • Comfort demonstrating product value and guiding customers toward broader adoption and better business outcomes
  • High ownership mentality with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and follow through consistently
  • Exceptional organization, time management, and attention to detail to deliver a reliable, high-quality onboarding experience

Who You Are:

  • A true customer advocate
  • Highly organized and results-oriented
  • Detail-obsessed (in the best way)
  • You know how to adapt your approach depending on who’s in front of you.
  • You are always looking for ways to improve and scale what works
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools quickly

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

User Experience Designer Job Type: Full-time

Position Summary Penn Foster Group is looking for a User Experience Designer to help create intuitive, engaging, and accessible digital learning experiences. In this role, you’ll work across the full UX design process—from understanding user needs and translating research into insights to designing and refining solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, UX researchers, educators, curriculum designers, and developers to create experiences that support learner success and align with technical and business goals. You’ll also use user feedback, research findings, and analytics to continuously improve the learning experience. What You’ll Do

  • Apply design and systems thinking to define problems, develop hypotheses, synthesize research, and identify experience principles that guide design decisions.
  • Help plan and facilitate workshops, co-creation sessions, and collaborative activities that support ideation, alignment, and shared understanding.
  • Communicate design concepts through sketches, wireframes, prototypes, and presentations.
  • Gather and incorporate feedback from users, stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to improve solutions.
  • Partner with engineering to develop design specifications, assess feasibility, support sprint planning, and perform design quality reviews.
  • Help execute and evolve a cohesive UX vision across multiple channels and products, ensuring experiences are consistent, scalable, and user-centered.
  • Stay current with UX tools, methods, technologies, trends, and best practices.
  • Adapt to changing project requirements and organizational priorities while maintaining a strong focus on user needs.

What You Bring

  • Experience applying user-centered design principles to create intuitive, engaging, and accessible digital experiences for diverse audiences.
  • Familiarity with research and data-driven design, including analyzing user or learner feedback and using insights to inform design decisions.
  • Understanding of learning management systems, content management systems, structured content, and core technology concepts such as APIs, databases, and dynamic systems.
  • Proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • A strong foundation in color, typography, layout, composition, prototyping, and scalable design systems.
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex design concepts clearly.
  • Experience documenting interaction designs, including user flows, states, and edge cases, and supporting accurate implementation by engineering teams.
  • A collaborative, curious, and adaptable approach to problem-solving.

Additional Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in design or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A portfolio demonstrating applied experience in modern UX and digital product design.
  • One to two years of experience in digital product design and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience creating prototypes and using research or data to inform design decisions and iterations.

Working Conditions & Hiring Process

  • U.S. Work Location Requirement: All employees must reside in and perform work within the United States. We do not support international remote work arrangements for this role.
  • Travel Expectations: While this is a remote position, occasional travel may be required for team meetings, company events, conferences, summits, and similar activities. Candidates must be willing and able to travel as needed.
  • On-Camera Work Environment: We operate in a highly collaborative, remote, on-camera culture. Employees are expected to be on camera during meetings unless extenuating circumstances apply.
  • Recorded Video Interviews: All video interviews conducted during the hiring process will be recorded to support internal hiring consistency and process improvement.
  • Background Checks: Employment with Penn Foster Group is contingent upon successfully completing applicable pre-employment screening requirements, which may include verification of employment history, education, and criminal background, where permitted by law.
  • Identity Verification (Form I-9): As part of our onboarding process, all hires must complete employment eligibility verification in compliance with federal law. This includes remote Form I-9 verification, which may require an in-person identity verification step with an authorized representative.

About Us At Penn Foster Group, we are transforming online learning to help learners by bringing together Penn Foster, CareerStep, Ashworth College, James Madison High School, the New York Institute of Photography, the New York Institute of Art and Design, and other education platforms. Together, we create an accelerated path to greater economic mobility through real-world skills and knowledge that enable learners to achieve long-term success in the workplaces of the future. Our history dates back to 1890 when our founder, Thomas Foster, pioneered distance education by offering training by mail for coal miners to get the necessary skills for safer jobs. Today, with the partners who use our education and training programs, we continue that mission of providing accessible training and education for in-demand skills and are building a workforce that’s prepared for the future job market. Equal Employment Opportunity We strive toward Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Penn Foster Group by intentionally building diverse teams – in identities, lived experiences, and ideas to create a culture where people feel connected to each other and have a sense of belonging. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion because it is the foundation that enables us to achieve what we set out to do as an organization – from maximizing the number of learners who can reach their goals while giving them the kinds of experiences we want them to have, to becoming the type of company we want to work in. What We Offer We offer a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, flexible spending, generous paid time off, sponsored volunteer opportunities, a 401K with a company match, and free access to our online programs.

Roofr is growing our Onboarding team, and we're looking for a Spanish-speaking Onboarding Manager (contract) to own the most important window in a customer's journey: the moment they sign to the moment they're live, confident, and getting real value from Roofr.

We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products.   • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of Roofr's onboarding playbook, building something that scales, not just something that works today.
  • Act as a trusted guide during a high-stakes window, helping customers prioritize, build good habits, and set themselves up for long-term success in Roofr.

  • 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or enablement within an SMB, B2B, or SaaS environment
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills across live calls, video meetings, email, and webinars
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and adapt your approach based on customer goals, maturity, and engagement level
  • Proven ability to manage customer needs while making thoughtful, outcome-driven recommendations
  • Comfort demonstrating product value and guiding customers toward broader adoption and better business outcomes
  • High ownership mentality with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and follow through consistently
  • Exceptional organization, time management, and attention to detail to deliver a reliable, high-quality onboarding experience

Who You Are:

  • Detail-obsessed (in the best way)

Für unser Team von Seminartrainern suchen wir Ihre (m/w/d) Unterstützung auf freiberuflicher Basis in dem Themenbereich KI/AI/Künstliche Intelligenz. Derzeit finden unsere Schulungen zu diesem Thema Online via Microsoft-Teams statt.

Aufgaben

Als freiberuflicher Seminartrainer (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie nach individueller Vereinbarung einzelne Seminarveranstaltungen aus unserem Weiterbildungsangebot. Hierzu zählen offene Seminare, offene Webinare, inhouse Seminare, inhouse Webinare, Vorträge, Workshops, Moderationen, Mediationen, Coachings, Assessment-Center, etc.

Qualifikation

Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss, bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Darüber hinaus haben Sie mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung. Im Falle eines Einsatzes für Coaching-Aufträge ist eine Coaching-Ausbildung erforderlich.

Im Vorfeld der Auftragsübernahme von Seminareinsätzen ist zur Qualitätssicherung ein Trainer-Onboarding der Dr. G. Kitzmann Akademie zu durchlaufen.

Benefits

Es ist Ihnen überlassen, für welche Seminarthemen (KI/AI/Künstliche Intelligenz, Führungstrainings, Kommunikationstrainings, Seminare Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, Seminare Arbeitsorganiation und Arbeitstechnik, Seminare Vertrieb & Verkauf, Seminare Einkauf, Seminare BWL & Recht, Seminare Digitalisierung) und Weiterbildungsformen (offene/ inhouse Seminare, Coachings, etc.) Sie auf freiberuflicher Basis angefragt werden möchten.

Sie sprechen fließend Englisch und haben Lust, Trainings in europäischen Hauptstädten durchzuführen? Dieses wird in Kürze im Rahmen einer freiberuflichen Trainertätigkeit innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe möglich sein.

Sie bezeichnen sich als verlässlich und loyal? Dasselbe dürfen Sie stets von uns erwarten!

Falls Ihnen diese beiden Attribute aus dem Herzen sprechen, würden wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung sehr freuen!

What You'll Do:

In this role, you will collaborate with senior leadership team members across the organization, managing diverse projects spanning various areas, including:

Market Assessment and Analysis: Conduct thorough industry and trend research, market analysis, and market sizing to address business challenges, evaluate potential M&A targets, and support Sales and Marketing growth for company investments.

This role offers a unique opportunity to engage in all aspects of successful B2B software company management, from strategic planning to execution.     • Bachelors or masters degree in business, economics, engineering, mathematics, philosophy, or related fields.
    • 5 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a similar analytical role, with a background in AI / software industry being advantageous.
    • Strong strategic thinking skills to derive and deliver key insights from data.
    • High-level of competency of data visualization tools (Power BI is a plus) and proficient in Excel and PowerPoint for effective reporting.
    • Sound knowledge of business financials and operations.
    • Ability to build and maintain relationships at the executive level.
    • Skilled in synthesizing trends and consolidating findings into meaningful, visually appealing formats for presentations to executives.
    • Excellent project management skills, communication abilities, and a self-starter attitude.
    • High curiosity, passion for continuous learning and creative problem-solving.
    • Demonstrated adaptability, flexibility, and willingness to travel occasionally (<20% of the time).

raw.excerpt: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate.  We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life.
raw.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Principal Data Engineer to define and evolve the architecture, engineering standards, and operating model for our enterprise data platform.

This role is for a technical leader who excels at complex system design: translating business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data products. The Principal Data Engineer will lead critical architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, governance, observability, and consumption, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, and pragmatic best practices.

You will work across engineering, analytics, platform, security, and business stakeholders to create systems that make trusted data accessible, timely, and actionable at scale.

What You’ll Do

Lead Data Architecture and System Design

  • Own the technical vision and architecture for scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms and pipelines.
  • Design end-to-end data systems spanning batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, data modeling, storage, orchestration, serving layers, and consumption patterns.
  • Make and document high-quality architecture decisions, including tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, scalability, latency, security, maintainability, and cost.
  • Define reusable architectural patterns for common data engineering challenges, including CDC, event-driven data flows, schema evolution, slowly changing dimensions, data quality, and multi-tenant or domain-oriented data models.
  • Establish clear boundaries and interfaces between operational systems, data platforms, analytics layers, and downstream applications.
  • Lead technical design reviews for high-impact initiatives and provide clear, constructive direction on implementation approaches.
  • Identify architectural risks early and drive plans to mitigate technical debt, single points of failure, data inconsistency, and operational fragility.

Set Engineering Standards and Best Practices

  • Establish and continuously improve standards for data engineering development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and lifecycle management.
  • Define best practices for version-controlled data transformations, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, and environment promotion.
  • Build a culture of data reliability by implementing standards for data contracts, schema management, lineage, observability, freshness, completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation.
  • Champion security, privacy, access control, governance, retention, and compliance requirements throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Develop practical engineering guardrails that enable teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality, trust, or operational excellence.
  • Drive adoption of well-defined SLIs, SLOs, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident learning practices for critical data products.

Drive Technical Decision-Making

  • Serve as a trusted technical authority for complex, cross-functional decisions involving data architecture, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering investments.
  • Facilitate technical discussions that turn ambiguous requirements into durable, well-reasoned solutions.
  • Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, platform technologies, and vendor capabilities using clear criteria and documented recommendations.
  • Align architecture decisions with organizational priorities, business outcomes, data strategy, and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Create and maintain architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and technical standards that provide clarity across teams.
  • Influence leaders and stakeholders through concise communication of technical options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward.

Build and Improve Data Products

  • Lead the design and development of high-value, production-grade data pipelines, datasets, and platform capabilities.
  • Partner with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to deliver well-modeled, discoverable, and trustworthy data products.
  • Optimize data systems for reliability, usability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Drive modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms, consolidation of fragmented pipelines, and reduction of manual operational processes.
  • Ensure data products are designed with clear ownership, documentation, lineage, quality expectations, and support models.

Mentor and Multiply Engineering Excellence

  • Mentor data engineers at all levels, with a particular focus on growing senior engineers into strong technical leaders.
  • Provide practical coaching on system design, data modeling, debugging, performance tuning, code quality, and production operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Establish reusable templates, reference implementations, and playbooks that improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-accountability engineering culture centered on thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and ownership.
  • Act as a technical multiplier: helping teams make better decisions independently while maintaining alignment with shared architectural principles.

What you bring

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years designing and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed data systems, or enterprise-grade data products.
  • Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end system design, including defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, designing resilient architectures, and delivering production systems.
  • Deep experience with modern data architecture concepts, such as lakehouse or warehouse platforms, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, orchestration, metadata management, and data governance.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar.
  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling practices across analytical, operational, and domain-oriented use cases.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, reliability, and security.
  • Proven ability to lead technical decisions across multiple teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across an organization.

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data product, or self-service platform patterns.
  • Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, lineage, privacy, and access-control tooling.
  • Experience supporting financial, revenue, operational, customer, or enterprise analytics domains.
  • Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, or AI/LLM data foundations.
  • Experience managing major data-platform migrations, modernization programs, or large-scale architectural transformations.

Leadership Competencies

  • Systems thinker: Connects individual technical decisions to broader platform, organizational, and business outcomes.
  • Pragmatic architect: Balances ideal-state architecture with incremental delivery and operational realities.
  • Technical judgment: Makes clear recommendations amid ambiguity and communicates tradeoffs transparently.
  • Builder and operator: Designs for production from the beginning, including reliability, security, observability, and supportability.
  • Mentor and multiplier: Develops others and creates scalable mechanisms for technical excellence.
  • Collaborative influencer: Builds alignment across engineering, analytics, security, product, and business teams.

Our Technology Stack

  • Languages & Databases: Python, SQL, MySQL, NoSQL databases
  • Orchestration & Transformation: Airflow, dbt
  • Data Platforms: Snowflake, AWS, GCP, BigQuery, Redshift
  • Data Integration: Fivetran, custom ETL/ELT frameworks
  • Observability & Data Reliability: Datadog, monitoring, alerting, data-quality frameworks

About the company Impare:

Imparé, a Silicon Valley–based startup and a subsidiary of Jaffer Business Systems (JBS), marks JBS's first international investment and a significant step toward advancing Pakistan's presence in the global semiconductor industry. With this milestone, JBS has positioned itself at the forefront of chip verification services in the country. The company is building a verification hub in Pakistan, designed to support leading semiconductor firms worldwide while nurturing local engineering talent. Through world-class training and real-world project exposure, Imparé empowers Pakistani engineers to collaborate with global technology leaders — bridging innovation, expertise, and opportunity across borders.

Role Overview

Identify, research, qualify, and prioritize potential customers matching Impare's ideal customer profile. Maintain accurate CRM records and coordinate timely follow-up after founder-led workshops and webinars. This is a research and coordination role; outreach, pitching, and substantive prospect conversations are handled by the Founder/CEO.

Job Responsibilities

  • Identify 40–60 relevant LinkedIn prospects per month, focusing on chip, SoC, and chiplet design and verification leaders at fabless AI infrastructure silicon companies.
  • Quality and rank leads based on funding status and proximity to a named tapeout date.
  • Record and update lead source, company, role, technical interest, relationship strength, last interaction, and next action in the CRM.
  • Log, score, and prepare follow-up details for all workshop and webinar registrants and attendees within 48 hours.
  • Pre-qualify leads before sharing them with the Founder/CEO, aiming for at least 80% to generate a reply or conversation.
  • Monitor changes in prospect roles, companies, and engagement, and flag renewed interest for timely follow-up.
  • Provide monthly insights on the prospect profiles, company types, and event topics generating the strongest leads.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or Engineering is required. Certifications in sales enablement, CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), or account management are preferred.

Experience

5-8 years of relevant experience in sales development, research, recruiting, or lead qualification is preferred.

﻿Experience in sales development, research, recruiting, or a similar role involving prospect identification and qualification. Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar tools and strong research judgment and CRM discipline are important. Semiconductor industry knowledge is helpful but not essential.

Damit diese Momente bei unserer Kundschaft ankommen, muss die Logistik funktionieren: pünktlich, vollständig und über alle Kanäle hinweg. Du wirst Teil des Logistik-Teams und arbeitest eng mit Speditionen, 3PLs und internen Teams zusammen. Du bist dabei nicht nur für den Ablauf zuständig, sondern denkst Abläufe mit und machst sie besser.

Transportplanung & Steuerung

  • Planung, Organisation und Steuerung nationaler und internationaler LKW-Transporte (FTL, LTL, Stückgut, KEP, Amazon)

Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Laufende Überwachung aller Sendungen

  • Proaktives Eingreifen bei Abweichungen, damit Abläufe reibungslos bleiben

Koordination & Kommunikation

  • Abstimmung mit Speditionen, 3PLs, Lieferanten und internen Teams

  • Sicherung von Slots und Terminen, Stakeholder immer auf dem aktuellen Stand

Zoll & Dokumente

  • Abwicklung der Zollformalitäten

  • Erstellung und Ablage der Versand- und Zolldokumente

Datenpflege & Systemarbeit

  • Saubere Pflege von Transport- und Kundendaten im ERP (Reybex)

  • Strukturierte Datenarbeit in Google Sheets / Excel

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Spedition und Logistik oder mehrjährige Erfahrung in der LKW-Disposition

  • 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Disposition

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. Reybex, SAP) und Dispositionstools

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Sheets / Excel (von Vorteil)

  • Deutschkenntnisse sehr gut in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse mindestens B2


Das sind die Charakterzüge, die dich beschreiben:

  • Du behältst den Überblick, auch wenn es hektisch wird

  • Du bringst starke operative Umsetzungsfähigkeit mit

  • Du kommunizierst klar, sachlich und lösungsorientiert

  • Du denkst analytisch und triffst auch unter Zeitdruck fundierte Entscheidungen


Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Remote mit Berlin als bevorzugtem Standort – du arbeitest remote, gern mit Anbindung an unser Team in Berlin

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – gestalte deinen Tag so, wie er dir passt

  • Homeoffice-Setup – 500 € Zuschuss für deinen Arbeitsplatz

  • Vollständig ausgestattet – Mac oder Windows, deine Wahl

  • Glow Card – 50 € monatlich, das sind 600 € extra im Jahr

  • Lernen – Zugang zu Glowcademy und Lernzeiten

  • Mitarbeiterrabatt – 40 % auf unser gesamtes Sortiment

  • Urlaub – 30 Tage + 1 persönlicher Feiertag + bis zu 10 unbezahlte Tage

  • Gesundheit – Betriebliche Krankenversicherung (600 €/Jahr)

  • Altersvorsorge – 600 € nach Probezeit, zzgl. 20 % Match

  • Kultur – Fünf Jahre in Folge Top Company auf Kununu

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Yay! Du hast es bis hierher geschafft!

Wenn du jetzt immer noch liest, ist die Wahrscheinlichkeit groß, dass wir ein Match sind.

Eine Sache liegt uns aber noch auf dem Herzen:
Trau dich! Vor allem als Frau, oder als jemand einer unterrepräsentierten Bevölkerungsgruppe. Auch wenn du nicht überall einen Haken setzen kannst, möchten wir dich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wir glauben, dass eine bunte Vielfalt von Perspektiven und Erfahrungen ein Team stärker macht - und je stärker unser Team ist, desto besser erreichen wir unsere Mission, Menschen zu mehr Energie im Alltag zu verhelfen.

You’ll work across Marketing, Product, Growth, CRM, Social, and Design to create communications for Moniepoint’s products and customers, from campaigns and product launches to CRM, social media content, performance ads, and everything in between, to develop messaging that supports acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer loyalty.

  • Translate complex financial products, features, and services into simple, relatable messaging that customers can understand and trust.
  • Write performance marketing copy for platforms including Google, Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn.
  • Maintain a consistent Moniepoint tone of voice across different communications and touchpoints.
  • Create culturally relevant content that reflects our customers' realities, behaviours, and everyday experiences.
  • Work closely with designers and other creatives to ensure copy and visual execution work together.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of professional copywriting experience, preferably in an agency, brand, fintech, technology, media, or consumer-facing environment.

About you:

  • Collaborative :You work well with designers, marketers, strategists, product teams, and other creatives and are open to feedback.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

This position is 100% remote and will be based in the UK, Ireland, France, the Netherlands.

GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.

Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.

We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.

What you’ll do

  • Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.
  • Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.
  • Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
  • Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.
  • Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.
  • Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.
  • Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.
  • Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).
  • Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.

What you’ll bring

  • Fluency in Italian.
  • Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.
  • Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.
  • Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.
  • Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.
  • Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.
  • Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.
  • The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.
  • Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.

About the team

As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.

Remote-Global

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Description

About Scytale

Scytale is a global leader, an AI-powered company transforming how organizations achieve and maintain trust and compliance. Our platform automates frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SOX ITGC, GDPR, PCI DSS, and 60+ more frameworks, making compliance smarter, faster, and continuously audit-ready.

Built for startups, scale-ups, and enterprises, Scytale combines intelligent automation, real-time monitoring, and AI-driven insights to reduce manual work and eliminate compliance blind spots. Recognized as a G2 Leader in GRC and an AWS Rising Star Partner of the Year, Scytale is trusted by hundreds of companies worldwide and known for its technology and partnership-driven approach.

Role Overview

We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our core R&D team and help build our cloud-based platform. You’ll work across the stack, shaping the architecture, implementing new features, optimizing performance, and mentoring team members to uphold high standards. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact on a platform automating IT auditing for SaaS companies globally.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years in Node.js and 2+ years in React, with experience building and operating production services at a meaningful scale.
  • Microservices Expertise: Proven production experience with microservices architecture.
  • Database Knowledge: Strong skills with relational and non-relational databases.
  • API Development: Experience building and integrating REST APIs.
  • AI-Augmented Development: Strong proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot) and modern AI-assisted development practices as part of day-to-day work.
  • Cloud Platforms: Familiarity with AWS or similar providers.
  • Leadership: Ability to mentor and lead technical projects.
  • Communication: Proficient in English with strong verbal and written skills.
  • DevOps Awareness: Knowledge of containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) is a strong advantage.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Proficient in software design principles and patterns with a motivated, self-driven approach.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience developing high-scale SaaS solutions.
  • Experience developing AI Features (Agents, GenAI, Lang etc.)
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD and QA automation processes.
  • Academic excellence in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Design: Develop Scytale’s cloud-based platform using cutting-edge technologies such as AWS, microservices, and containerized solutions.
  • Architect Solutions: Participate in architectural decisions, research, and design to deliver scalable and robust software.
  • Full-Stack Development: Implement backend logic, create intuitive frontends, and integrate with third-party APIs.
  • Collaborate: Work closely with product, stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure a seamless, efficient platform.
  • Lead & Mentor: Guide junior developers, promote knowledge sharing, and maintain coding standards.
  • Optimize: Continuously improve the platform’s efficiency, scalability, and maintainability, while staying updated on industry trends.

Benefits

Why Join Scytale?

﻿● Innovative Work: Be part of a cutting-edge product shaping the future of security and compliance, from wherever you work best.

● Real Ownership: Join a fast-moving R&D team where your work has direct impact on the product, architecture, and customer experience.

● Remote-Friendly Collaboration: Work closely with experienced product and engineering teams through clear communication, strong processes, and a culture built on trust.

● Learning & Growth: Grow your career through mentorship, knowledge sharing, courses, and exposure to modern technologies and AI-assisted development practices.

● Independence with Support: Enjoy the autonomy of remote work while staying connected to a collaborative, supportive team that values initiative and accountability.

● Global Impact: Help build a platform used by companies worldwide to simplify and transform cybersecurity compliance.

Ready to innovate and grow with us? Join Scytale and help transform cybersecurity compliance for companies worldwide!

raw.description:
Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

About the role

The Senior Transformation Manager plays a key role in leading enterprise transformation initiatives that drive strategic goals, program and project support, and cross-functional coordination. This position is responsible for overseeing complex cross-functional programs and implementation of go-to-market, client success, operational, and financial improvement efforts. The Senior Transformation Manager leverages strong analytical skills, financial acumen, and project execution capabilities to help translate strategic objectives into actionable programs. Working closely with business leaders, finance, operations, product and other transformation partners to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and ensure successful delivery of transformation outcomes and maximize value creation.

Location: This position is located at our Dublin, OH campus with hybrid flexibility or may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America.

What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)

Strategy and Value Creation Planning:

  • Partner with Product Transformation team to support multi-year planning and goal setting.
  • Define KPIs and performance metrics to track progress against strategic goals.
  • Support initiative prioritization and sequencing based on risk, dependencies, and impact.
  • Ability to build relationships and communicate effectively from frontline teams to executive leadership.
  • Prepare presentation materials and status updates for executive-level reporting.

Transformation Execution, Delivering against value capture & transformation opportunities:

  • Manage initiative workplans, timelines, and execution status.
  • Collaborate with initiative leads and cross-functional teams to support the execution of key deliverables.
  • Facilitate working sessions, maintain project documentation, and track milestones.
  • Monitor and report progress toward benefit realization; highlight issues and support resolution.
  • Use data and performance metrics to assess progress, identify course corrections, and support benefit Realization.
  • Apply continuous improvement methods to identify inefficiencies and suggest corrective actions.
  • Support change management activities to help drive adoption and sustainability of transformation efforts.
  • All other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring (Qualifications)

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 2-3 years of experience in healthcare, health plans, population health, care navigation, employer benefits or healthcare data environments.
  • Proven self-starter with the ability to excel in ambiguity and drive the path forward with limited prescriptive direction.
  • Positive, people-oriented, and energized by working in a high-performance, fast-paced industry.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional teams and projects with measurable outcomes.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to distill complex information into executive-ready formats.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft office and other data tools as necessary.
  • Working knowledge of project management and change enablement practices.
  • High level of curiosity, adaptability, and a proactive problem-solving mindset.
  • A high degree of personal accountability and trustworthiness, a commitment to working within Quantum Health’s policies, values and ethics, and to protecting the sensitive data entrusted to us.

--

What’s in it for you:

  • Compensation: Competitive base and incentive compensation
  • Coverage: Health, vision and dental featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
  • Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.

Structural Integrity Associates, Inc. (SIA) is seeking an Engineering Consultant to join our Nuclear Analytical Service team, with a primary focus on ASME Section III, Division 5 elevated-temperature design, creep-fatigue evaluation, and advanced reactor applications. This position may be based remotely or in one of our office locations.

This role will support high-temperature structural analyses, creep-fatigue assessments, elevated-temperature design evaluations, and development/testing of engineering software tools supporting advanced reactor technologies and the existing nuclear fleet.

Primary Responsibilities: - Support ASME Section III, Division 5 stress, fatigue, creep-fatigue, and elevated-temperature evaluations
- Support existing nuclear fleet and advanced reactor design, including high-temperature materials and code evaluations
- Interact with clients to provide engineering solutions, code interpretations, results, and analyses
- Contribute to proposals for project development and scoping
- Manage technical projects that offer solutions to industry clients (mid/senior level)
- Develop new leads and project opportunities with clients (mid/senior level)

Required Skills/Qualifications:
- BS degree in Mechanical Engineering and/or Materials Engineering
- Minimum of 6-10 years of experience in the following fields:
  • Design Engineering experience with ASME Section III, Division 5 for advanced reactor/elevated-temperature applications
  • Materials degradation and high-temperature behavior, including fatigue, EAF, creep, and creep-fatigue
  • Finite Element Analysis (FEA) using tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, and Python-based analysis tools.
  • Programs Engineering including Inservice Inspection and License Renewal (Initial and Subsequent)
  • Operation of Nuclear Plant Systems
  • Experience with domestic U.S. commercial nuclear fleet reactor designs (PWR/BWR) and/or advanced reactor designs
- Experience with NRC regulations and business protocol
- Excellent written and oral communication skills including presentations

Desired Skills/Qualifications:
- MS degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering and/or Materials Engineering
- Experience in the following fields:
  • Active ASME Code Committee membership and engagement
  • Knowledge of advanced nuclear reactor design and high-temperature design rules
  • Materials science background in high-temperature materials, creep mechanisms, and creep-fatigue damage assessment.
- Professional Engineer (PE) License

The salary for this role will be commensurate with experience and location. For candidates in Denver, CO, the expected salary range is $104,080 to 144,400. For candidates in San Jose, CA, the expected salary range is $123,040 to $171,000. For candidates in Huntersville, NC, the expected salary range is $96,880 to $135,000.

SIA is an engineering consulting firm serving various industries including Nuclear Power, Energy Services, Pipeline Integrity, and Critical Infrastructure. Our employees are members of a distinct community of internationally respected professionals committed to quality, engineering innovation and a shared goal of building a safer world.

SIA offers a competitive salary and performance-based bonus program. Our retirement benefits include a Traditional 401k, Roth 401k, and an employer match. GolfNow is seeking a Director, Product Management to lead product initiatives and develop Product Management talent across our B2B golf technology portfolio.

You’ll combine product expertise, strategic thinking, and people leadership to improve the technology that helps golf course operators manage their businesses and drive growth. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and business leadership, you’ll translate business objectives into coordinated product priorities and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, adoption, and commercial performance.

You’ll bring an AI-native approach to Product Management, using AI and modern tools to improve effectiveness while developing these capabilities across your team.

Why This Role Matters:

You’ll play a key role in advancing GolfNow’s B2B products while building a strong Product Management team. Your success will be measured by the customer and business outcomes achieved and your ability to develop Product Managers who demonstrate sound judgment, ownership, and accountability.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead Product Ownership: Build deep expertise across GolfNow’s B2B portfolio and develop Product Managers who take accountability for customer experience, product performance, and business outcomes.
  • Translate Strategy Into Product Direction: Partner with senior leadership to translate business objectives into coordinated product priorities and roadmaps. Evaluate opportunities and tradeoffs across products while contributing to broader portfolio strategy.

  • Build and Develop a High-Performing Product Team: Lead, coach, and develop Product Managers. Establish clear expectations, strengthen product judgment, and create an environment that encourages accountability and professional growth.
  • Strengthen Cross-Functional Leadership: Build effective partnerships across Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, Sales, and business leadership. Align teams around priorities, resolve dependencies, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly.
  • Accelerate Execution and Business Results: Establish meaningful success measures, guide complex product initiatives, and use customer insights and performance data to

What You Bring:

  • Significant Product Management experience, preferably 10+ years, with demonstrated success leading complex products, portfolios, or cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience managing, coaching, and developing Product Managers, including strengthening team capabilities and accountability.
  • Experience with B2B software or technology products and demonstrated success improving customer experience, adoption, retention, or commercial performance.
  • Strong strategic thinking and product judgment, with the ability to translate business objectives into coordinated priorities, navigate ambiguity, and make informed tradeoffs.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using customer research, product metrics, and market insights to guide decisions.
  • Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, architecture, scalability, and engineering tradeoffs, combined with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and technology leaders.
  • An AI-native approach to Product Management, with the ability to leverage AI and automation effectively while developing these capabilities across a team.

How We Do It:

At Versant, how we work is as important as what we deliver. Successful candidates demonstrate:

  • Trust: Build credibility through integrity, sound judgment, accountability, and consistent follow-through while creating an environment where team members can take ownership.
  • Teamwork: Foster collaboration across Product, Engineering, Design, and business functions while supporting the development and success of others.
  • Transparency: Communicate priorities, decisions, risks, and results openly, and create clarity for team members and stakeholders.
  • Agility: Help teams adapt to changing business priorities, customer needs, and emerging information without losing focus on outcomes.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Encourage innovation, thoughtful experimentation, proactive problem-solving, and the pursuit of new opportunities that create customer and business value.

We value demonstrated product leadership, people development, sound judgment, and measurable business impact alongside relevant professional experience.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience leading Product Management teams responsible for multiple B2B SaaS products or integrated technology platforms.
  • Experience developing products for golf course operators, hospitality businesses, or operationally complex B2B environments.
  • Knowledge of the golf industry, golf course operations, or related technology ecosystems.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

At GolfNow, you’ll have the opportunity to influence the direction of our B2B technology portfolio while developing Product Management talent. You’ll work closely with business and technology leaders, help solve meaningful customer challenges, and build a team that delivers lasting customer and business value.

This position is remote, with the expectation of occasional in-person collaboration for team meetings, strategic planning sessions, and other business needs.

While there is no formal on-call rotation, this role requires flexibility to participate in the response to critical production issues outside regular business hours when necessary.

Role Summary

The Senior Microsoft Dynamics GP Consultant serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients utilizing Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) across a variety of industries. This role is responsible for providing functional consulting, application support, troubleshooting, solution design, and business process optimization for Dynamics GP and related third-party applications.

Working directly with clients, the consultant will help resolve complex business and system challenges, recommend best practices, support upgrades and enhancements, and ensure clients maximize the value of their Dynamics GP investment. This is a highly client-facing role requiring strong consulting skills, deep Dynamics GP expertise, and the ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders across finance, operations, sales, customer service, and leadership teams.

Positions Responsibilities

Dynamics GP Consulting & Client Advisory

  • Serve as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics GP, providing guidance and recommendations to clients across multiple industries.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Dynamics GP solutions.
  • Lead solution design sessions, business process reviews, and system optimization initiatives.
  • Assist clients with system enhancements, upgrades, module implementations, and process improvements.
  • Recommend best practices that improve operational efficiency, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing exceptional service and trusted advice.

Application Support & Issue Resolution

  • Provide advanced functional support for core Dynamics GP modules, including Financial Management, Distribution, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales Order Processing, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets, Payroll, and Field Service.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, transactional, and configuration issues.
  • Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, posting errors, reconciliation issues, workflow challenges, and integration-related concerns.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end processes.
  • Collaborate with technical consultants and developers to identify and resolve system issues.

Business Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing client processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Configure Dynamics GP to support evolving business requirements.
  • Support workflow automation, approval processes, and operational efficiencies.
  • Help clients improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and system adoption.
  • Assist with documenting business processes and future-state recommendations.

Third-Party Applications & Integrations

  • Support and troubleshoot third-party applications commonly integrated with Dynamics GP, including SalesPad and other ISV solutions.
  • Assist with integration troubleshooting between Dynamics GP and external business systems.
  • Advise clients on configuration options, process impacts, and best practices when utilizing integrated applications.
  • Work collaboratively with software vendors and client stakeholders to resolve issues and implement enhancements.

Training, Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Deliver user training and knowledge transfer sessions for clients.
  • Create and maintain functional documentation, process guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document solutions, root causes, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to team knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Identify recurrent issues and recommend long-term corrective measures.

Required Skills

  • Deep functional knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a focus on root cause analysis and data integrity.
  • Ability to understand and improve business processes through technology solutions.
  • Excellent client relationship management and consulting skills.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Experience working within a managed services, consulting, or support environment.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Desired Skills

  • Bilingual in English and French
  • Experience with SmartConnect and Dynamics GP integrations
  • Familiarity with SQL Server and Dynamics GP reporting tools
  • Previous experience in a Microsoft partner or consulting environment.

About Us

Endeavour Solutions is a top Microsoft Partner for ERP, CRM, and AI Cloud Business Applications providing SMB, mid-market, and corporate clients with advisory services, implementation & training, and ongoing support for their Microsoft Business Applications. Key focus areas include Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Business Central, and Dynamics GP, supporting clients across the United States and Canada.|

With offices coast-to-coast across Canada and the United States, Endeavour Solutions works with over 1,100 active clients spanning each of the major time zones across North America. Founded in 1989, Endeavour operates several key brands, including Endeavour Solutions, GP Support North, and Purely CRM.

Salary & Benefits

  • The salary range for this role is between $90,000 - $120,000, depending on years of comparable experience, skill set, and the unique value you bring.
  • Must be legally entitled to work in Canada or the United States and be available for occasional travel in Canada and the USA.

Transparency Statement

This posting reflects an existing vacancy.

Qualified candidates will be asked to complete a Predictive Index survey as part of the application process.
