Description

MWDN is an international recruitment and outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience connecting exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. In this role, MWDN acts as the recruitment partner, and the selected candidate will work directly with the client’s team on their product in an international environment

What is your new project?

  • Domain: Cybersecurity
  • Location: Israel
  • Company size: 11-50 employees
  • Founded in: 2020

What makes this project exciting?

The customer is one-stop-shop for Online Cyber Defense Solutions - an organization dedicated to Information Security and Cyber Defense in all ways and shapes. Their team of experts and specialists put the client’s defense ahead in order to solve the issue and ensure it won't repeat.

We are looking for a mid-level Product Designer who combines strong interaction and visual design skills with a practical approach to solving user problems.

You will take features from problem definition through to implementation, translating complex workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces. You should be comfortable working independently, explaining your design decisions, and collaborating closely with developers.

What makes you a great fit

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Product Designer, working on B2B SaaS products.
  • A portfolio of shipped work that demonstrates your design process, decision-making, and individual contribution. Experience limited to landing pages or marketing websites is not sufficient.
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, particularly for complex, data-heavy interfaces.
  • Familiarity with mobile and responsive design, including adapting complex desktop workflows for smaller screens.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including prototyping and reusable component creation.
  • Experience working with and contributing to design systems.
  • Ability to take ownership of features and work independently.
  • Clear communication skills and experience collaborating with developers.
  • Fluent English.

A portfolio is required to be considered for an interview. Please include a link with your application.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Own the design of product features end to end, from understanding the problem to delivering designs and supporting implementation.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Design clear, efficient interfaces for complex sales workflows, including pipelines, tables, and dashboards.
  • Help shape the product’s mobile experience, beginning with responsive web and adapting complex interfaces for smaller screens.
  • Conduct lightweight user research and usability testing to validate ideas and improve designs.
  • Contribute to the design system by creating and refining reusable components and interaction patterns.
  • Collaborate with developers to communicate design intent, address implementation questions, and ensure the quality of shipped features.

Our next steps

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Client interview — ✅ Offer

Welcome to Jackrabbit Technologies.

Jackrabbit Technologies is the leading provider of software and services that help youth activity centers -- gymnastics, dance, cheer, swim, music, childcare, and others -- grow and operate efficiently. We are an entrepreneurial-minded, rapidly growing SaaS company that has been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in North Carolina and one of North Carolina’s Top Industry-Driven Technology Companies. Jackrabbit Technologies’ SaaS solution powers over 7,000 clients in 35 countries around the world.

Our Culture Empowers YOU!

We hire people passionate about what they do, provide them with the tools to succeed, and then get out of their way! Living our vision, mission, and values, our people are what make Jackrabbit Technologies an awesome place to work. And that “awesome place” is virtual -- all of our employees enjoy the privilege of working remotely. We always have and always will. So, you must have reliable high-speed internet access. We are interested in speaking to qualified candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. Jackrabbit is not able to sponsor employment visas for this position.

What You'll Do:

The Implementation Consultant is responsible for guiding clients through onboarding, implementation, and system optimization initiatives that help them successfully adopt and utilize Jackrabbit. This role partners closely with clients to understand their business operations, recommend effective workflows, and support successful platform adoption.

You will lead implementation projects, provide consulting and training, and help clients align their business processes with Jackrabbit functionality. This role works closely with Support, Product, Client Success, and other Client Experience teams to deliver a consistent and successful onboarding experience.

Success in this role requires strong consulting skills, project management, problem-solving, client communication, and the ability to translate business needs into practical system solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Consulting & Solution Design

  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand client business processes, goals, and operational needs.
  • Evaluate client operational practices and independently develop implementation strategies and workflow recommendations based on each client's unique business objectives, operational complexity, and long-term growth plans.
  • Identify risks and opportunities that may impact implementation success.
  • Guide clients toward scalable and efficient solutions that support long-term adoption.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the implementation process.

Implementation Delivery & Project Management

  • Lead implementation engagements from onboarding through launch and transition.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, deliverables, and client expectations.
  • Coordinate implementation activities and ensure clients remain on track throughout the onboarding journey.
  • Monitor implementation progress and proactively address risks or challenges.
  • Support successful transitions to ongoing support and account management teams.

System Optimization & Client Enablement

  • Conduct system audits and workflow reviews to improve client outcomes.
  • Assist clients with configuration challenges, operational workflows, and system utilization.
  • Deliver training, consulting, and guidance that helps clients maximize value from the platform.
  • Translate complex functionality into practical recommendations and actionable next steps.
  • Provide insights to help clients achieve operational efficiency and business goals.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Product, Support, Research, Client Success, and other teams to support successful client outcomes.
  • Share client feedback, workflow insights, and implementation trends that help improve the client experience.
  • Contribute implementation knowledge, best practices, and workflow expertise to support organizational learning and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of implementation resources, standards, and onboarding best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes and client adoption outcomes.

What You're About:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Education, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in implementation, consulting, client success, customer onboarding, professional services, or related customer-facing roles.
  • Advanced consulting, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Ability to analyze business processes and translate client needs into practical system solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for client engagements, conferences, and business needs.
  • Must reside in the Pacific Time Zone (PT) to ensure business continuity and lead implementations for our West Coast clients.
  • Must have reliable high-speed internet access.
  • US Citizens or Green Card holders with no special circumstances living in the US.

Preferred:

  • Experience working within SaaS, software, or technology environments.
  • Experience supporting onboarding, implementation, or client adoption initiatives.
  • Experience facilitating training, consulting engagements, or workflow discovery sessions.
  • Experience working with business systems, operational workflows, or process improvement initiatives.

What You'll Love About Us:

  • Our Culture! Check out our mission, core values and the many awards we have received as a growing business and employer of choice.
  • We work remotely. We always have - we always will!
  • Our Health and Wellness Benefits. Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending, HSA, and Dependent Care Accounts.
  • We help you with the unexpected. Company-Paid Disability and Life Insurance. Opportunity to elect Critical Illness and Accident Insurance. Plus confidential access to legal and life counseling and mental health support available 24/7.
  • Your future looks bright at Jackrabbit. 401(k) with a generous company match, access to financial planning.
  • We pay you to play, rest, recharge, and balance your life. Paid Time Off, Paid Parental, Paid Caregiver, and Sabbatical leaves.
  • You will grow your skills with us. Annual allowance for professional development.
  • We give back. Paid Time to volunteer in your community.

Jackrabbit is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination or harassment. We expect every member of the Jackrabbit team to do their part to cultivate and maintain an environment where everyone has the opportunity to feel included and is afforded the respect and dignity they deserve.

Decisions related to hiring, compensating, training, evaluating performance, or terminating are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees. We examine our unconscious biases and take responsibility for always striving to create an inclusive environment that makes every employee and candidate feel welcome.

The remote High School Social Studies Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering specific course content in an online environment. Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Teachers monitor student progress through Stride K12’s learning management system. They actively work closely with students and parents/learning coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, such as state testing or as otherwise required by the school.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Digital Academy of Texas (DATX). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Digital Academy of Texas (DATX) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

This is a full-time REMOTE position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

ESSENTIAL FUNCATIONS: Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Provides rich and engaging synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences for students

  • Commitment to personalizing learning for all students

  • Demonstrates a belief in all students’ ability to succeed and meet high expectations

  • Differentiates instruction based on student level of mastery

  • Augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools under guidance from principal and coach

  • Maintains grade book ensuring student academic integrity, makes student placement and promotion decisions, and alerts administrators to concerns about student performance and progress

  • Prepares students for high stakes standardized tests

  • Understands that a primary responsibility is to establish and maintain positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with and responds to students and learning coaches/parents in a timely manner

  • Supports learning coaches/parents with student curricular and instructional issues, as well as basic troubleshooting in a virtual classroom environment that is in line with academy policies and procedures

  • Travels as required (on average once per month and/or approximately 20% of the time) for face-to-face professional development, student testing, and as required by school

  • Bachelor's degree AND

  • Active state teaching license AND

  • Ability to clear required background check

OTHER REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work collaboratively with other teachers to interpret and produce numeric, tabular, and graphic representations of student data, and use it to drive instructional decisions.

  • Receptive to receiving coaching regularly with administrators and teacher trainers.

  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint.

  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms.

  • Ability to maintain teacher certification/professional development hours and fluency in K12 systems, programs and curriculum.

DESIRED QUALIFICATION:

  • Experience working with proposed age group.

  • Experience supporting adults and children in the use of technology.

  • Experience teaching in an online (virtual) and/or in a brick-and-mortar environment.

  • Experience with online learning platforms.

Guidehouse is seeking a Databricks Data Analyst to join our AI & Data team to support client projects involving data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, and advanced analytics solution delivery. This role focuses on working with data to generate insights, build analytical datasets, and support decision-making across client and internal teams. The role requires strong SQL and data visualization skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders to deliver accurate, secure, and well-documented data-driven solutions.

This position offers virtual work flexibility within the United States. While remote candidates will be considered, preference will be given to candidates located near a Guidehouse office in one of the following markets: Arlington, VA; Washington, DC; New York, NY; Chicago, IL; Austin, TX; Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; and Boulder, CO.

Please note, this requisition supports hiring across multiple levels to support our Databricks Data Analyst Teams. The posted salary range represents a range of potential compensation and will vary based on the selected candidate’s experience, qualifications, location, and the level at which the position is filled.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain analytical datasets and data models using Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, and related tools.

  • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries and Python notebooks to support reporting, analysis, and business use cases.

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using BI tools such as Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Power BI, Tableau, and Databricks SQL.

  • Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and insights that support business decisions.

  • Translate business requirements into analytical datasets, queries, dashboards, and reporting solutions.

  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and issue resolution to support accuracy, consistency, and reliable reporting outputs.

  • Work with cross-functional teams including data engineers, data scientists, solution architects, and client stakeholders.

  • Communicate analytical findings, reporting logic, and business insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Document data models, transformations, assumptions, and business logic to support transparency, reuse, and ongoing maintenance.

  • Support data governance, access control, security, lineage, and compliance standards within the Databricks platform.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or another relevant field.

  • 3-10 years of relevant experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or analytical solution delivery.

  • Strong experience with SQL for data querying, transformation, analysis, and reporting.

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis, automation, or exploratory analytics.

  • Experience with Databricks or similar cloud-native analytics platforms.

  • Experience with BI reporting tools such as Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Power BI, or Tableau.

We observe that many voters are busy, distracted, and impatient. We have a goal of providing a complete voting experience in 8 minutes, including the download of our app ("WeVote Ballot Guide, @WeVote"). More information is at WeVote.US. See Twitter @WeVote. We have built 8 teams of Interns, led by experienced professionals who have a strong connection to academia and our mission. Beyond political research, we are always looking to offer ways you can build your professional skills, and grow as a person in a way that leads to your future success.

We welcome volunteers of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, ages, income levels, and political perspectives—everyone committed to fair, accessible elections. Whether you’re new or bring years of experience, there’s a place for you. We know that unpaid roles present barriers. About the Team

CircleCI’s Talent Acquisition team is a high-performing team supporting a dynamic, high-growth technology environment. We partner closely with leaders across the business to attract exceptional talent, solve complex hiring challenges, and build the teams that drive CircleCI forward.

Our team values autonomy, ownership, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. We operate with a high degree of trust and expect each person to take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and bring practical solutions to the business.

About the Role

As a GTM Recruiter, you’ll lead full-cycle recruiting across Sales, Support/Field Engineering, Marketing, and some G&A functions. You’ll partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to hire talent across a broad range of roles and levels.

This is a highly visible role that requires hands-on recruiting with business partnership. You’ll apply proven recruiting strategies, build strong talent pipelines, advise stakeholders on market realities, and keep searches moving through shifting priorities and competing demands.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting process across GTM with a focus on Sales, spanning individual contributors through management.
  • Execute targeted recruiting strategies, including proactive sourcing, market mapping, and talent pipeline development, using AI-assisted research and sourcing tools to expand reach and move faster.
  • Build trusted partnerships with hiring managers and senior leaders, translating business priorities into actionable recruiting plans and informed hiring recommendations.
  • Keep searches moving by setting clear expectations with hiring teams, navigating competing priorities, and following up for timely decisions.
  • Advise hiring teams on talent availability, market dynamics, compensation expectations, and the trade-offs between speed, quality, and business needs.
  • Use recruiting and AI-powered market insights consistently to evaluate funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve recruiting processes and outcomes.
  • Independently prioritize a dynamic portfolio of searches, taking ownership of challenges and implementing practical solutions with minimal oversight.
  • Leverage AI and automation to streamline recruiting workflows, reduce manual work, and improve efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and responsible data practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4-6 years of recruiting experience, with a strong track record across Sales and broader Go-to-Market functions.
  • Experience recruiting commercial talent and assessing candidates across different roles and levels.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience navigating complex compensation packages, including commission-based structures and sales incentives.
  • Ability to build credibility with senior stakeholders, offer candid input constructively, and keep searches accountable without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong business awareness and an understanding of how recruiting supports organizational goals, market realities, and commercial priorities.
  • A high degree of ownership, initiative, and adaptability, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing demands, and drive outcomes independently.
  • Strong communication, prioritization, and analytical skills, including the ability to use recruiting metrics and market insights to guide decisions.
  • Practical AI fluency, including experience applying AI tools to improve recruiting effectiveness, automate repetitive tasks, and build more efficient workflows.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience recruiting within B2B SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, DevOps, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Experience supporting rapidly evolving Go-to-Market organizations in a lean or high-growth environment.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled recruiting workflows or automations with measurable results.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About Engine

At Engine, we're transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we're here to change that.

We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That's why we're building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we're looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In's Best Places to Work.

About the Role

As Partner Success Manager, Technology Partners, you will own a portfolio of Engine's technology and distribution partner relationships: OTAs, GDS partners, connectivity and channel partners. You will be the day-to-day technical and commercial point of contact responsible for partner health, integration performance, and revenue growth across your book.

This is a technical account management role. You will run the operating rhythm of your accounts: keeping integrations healthy and content accurate, resolving issues at the root cause with partner and Engine engineering teams, bringing newly signed connections live, and growing the revenue that flows through each partner. Your mandate is to grow and operate the partnerships in your book.

The role needs technical fluency, commercial awareness, and strong organizational discipline. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Connectivity, Pricing, Operations, and Finance to turn partner issues and opportunities into delivered outcomes.

You will work with both engineering and commercial leaders at partner companies. We're looking for someone who can debug a failing booking flow with a partner's engineers in the morning and run a business review with their commercial team in the afternoon.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of technology and distribution partner accounts, including OTAs, GDS partners, connectivity and channel partners, as the primary relationship owner and day-to-day technical and commercial point of contact
  • Monitor integration and API health across your book (availability and response times, error rates, throughput against rate limits, look-to-book, booking success) and act before degradation reaches travelers
  • Own content quality with each partner: availability and rate accuracy, property and room mapping, and data quality. Find where content is missing, stale, and drive the fix
  • Lead incident escalation for partner-related issues. Triage severity and blast radius, coordinate with partner and Engine engineering teams, work out whether the fault sits with Engine or the partner, and see root-cause analysis and corrective actions through to closure
  • Onboard and activate new connectivity sources and expanded scopes once signed: requirements, credentials and access, certification and testing, go-live, and early monitoring. Hand off to steady state with clear success criteria
  • Grow revenue through your partners by improving conversion and booking reliability, expanding content coverage and use cases, and making sure connected content is live, competitive, and actually booked
  • Run the partner cadence: QBRs, technical and performance reviews, working sessions, and escalation paths. Hold both sides to agreed commitments
  • Translate partner capabilities, roadmap changes, and API version updates into clear technical requirements for Engine Product and Engineering, and represent Engine's needs in partners' roadmaps
  • Support leadership on commercial terms and renewals: prepare performance and volume analysis, model incentive and tier programs, track terms and obligations, and manage follow-through
  • Maintain accurate partner records, integration documentation, contacts, contract terms, and issue logs
  • Track developments in travel distribution and connectivity (API standards, distribution models, and partner platform changes) to inform partner conversations and internal priorities

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in technical account management, partner or integration management, solutions or implementation roles, or a similar partner-facing role at a travel technology, API, or platform business
  • Working technical fluency: comfortable reading API documentation, inspecting XML and JSON requests and responses, reviewing logs, and testing calls with tools like Postman. SQL, or comfort pulling and analyzing your own data, is strongly preferred
  • A working understanding of travel distribution architecture: how content moves between suppliers, CRS, channel managers, switches, GDSs, OTAs, and aggregators, and where it tends to break
  • Commercial account management instincts: you connect integration performance to revenue, find growth opportunities, and make a data-backed case for them
  • A track record of resolving complex, multi-party technical issues through structured triage, clear ownership, and disciplined follow-through
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, so you can manage several partner workstreams, incidents, and onboardings at the same time without dropping anything
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication with both technical and commercial audiences, including partner executives
  • Comfortable using AI and modern tools to streamline workflows, speed up diagnosis, and operate well in a fast-moving environment

Applications for this role will be accepted through January 28, 2027 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

OTE Compensation

Your OTE (on-target earnings) are based on several factors including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition, all roles receive equity. raw.title: AI Agent Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
raw.excerpt: Company OverviewOrbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is building the agentic AI capability its mission support operations run on, and the AI Agent Engineer builds and operates it. Sixty percent of this role is common to every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis: designing, building, and deploying the multi-agent workflows behind triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing. The remaining forty percent is this role's focus — the cloud platform those workflows run on. This engineer owns the footprint across GCP, Cloudflare, and Azure, manages it as code, and holds its networking, security posture, and run cost to a standard that survives scrutiny as volume grows.

Travel: Occasional (up to 10%) to McLean, VA or team offsites as needed

Key Responsibilities — Common Core (60% of the Role)

Every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis, regardless of focus area, owns the following:

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows. Architect and ship the multi-agent and automated workflows that run in production: triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing.
  • Translate in both directions. Explain to non-technical stakeholders what the systems do, where they are reliable, and where they are not, in terms those stakeholders can act on. Equally, take a process owner's plain-language description of how their work happens and turn it into a workflow specification that holds up.
  • Partner with process owners to build what they actually need. Work directly and iteratively with the colleagues who own a process so the resulting capability fits their operation rather than forcing them to fit it. Push back constructively when a stated requirement will not survive contact with production.
  • Keep the workflows reliable. Monitor what is running in production, diagnose failures across prompts, tools, data, and orchestration, and resolve them. Know which problems are yours to solve and when to bring in engineering.
  • Own the cost of execution. Track what your AI workloads cost to run. Identify where a tighter prompt, a caching layer, or a simple deterministic step delivers the same outcome, and keep those costs defensible as volume grows.
  • Set the quality bar for AI-assisted output. Define accuracy standards, human review checkpoints, and escalation criteria for the automated workflows, and build the checks that prove those standards are being met.
  • Document what you build. Author and maintain the runbooks and SOPs that allow others to operate and troubleshoot these workflows without you. Nothing lives only in one person's head.
  • Integrate across Orbis products. Work across Catalyst, Pulse, and Discovery, with engineering support where needed, so workflows can access and act on the data they require.
  • Deliver the reporting leadership and the team depend on. Build and maintain the outputs behind resolution rate, escalation rate, output accuracy, response time, and employee satisfaction, and turn the Senior Operations Manager's requirements into structured, recurring reports and data exports.
  • Close capability gaps and keep the practice current. Recognize when a need is not served by existing tooling, scope the gap clearly, and either build it or bring it to engineering and product with enough detail to act on. Track developments in agentic AI tooling and enterprise automation platforms, and form a defensible view on what is worth adopting, at what pace, and for which use cases.

Focus Area — Cloud Infrastructure (40% of the Role)

In addition to the common core above, this role owns the cloud infrastructure Orbis depends on — both the enterprise platform behind internal operations and the environments that support client delivery:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain the Orbis cloud footprint across GCP, AWS, Cloudflare, and Azure, spanning both enterprise workloads and client delivery environments.
  • Define and manage that footprint as infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible, reviewable, and recoverable.
  • Own networking, identity, and secrets handling for agent workloads, including the boundaries between environments and the audit of access.
  • Hold the security posture of the platform and keep it evidenced rather than asserted.
  • Track and control platform run cost across compute, inference, storage, and egress, and report it in terms leadership can act on.
  • Build and maintain the deployment and release path — CI/CD, environment promotion, rollback — so shipping an agent workflow is routine rather than an event.

Required Qualifications

Orbis weighs what a candidate has built over tenure or credentials. The following are true minimum requirements for this role:

  • Must have 5 years of proven experience translating user requirements into wireframes, workflows and such.
  • Must have 1-year proven experience utilizing Claude or similar commercial offering to build AI agents.
  • Demonstrated experience building a functioning multi-agent workflow, with the ability to walk through the design rationale, how the agents hand off work and share context, what broke, and how it was fixed
  • Practical command of prompt engineering, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool or function calling
  • Proven ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences — describing a system's behavior, limits, and failure modes to a process owner or executive without hedging or retreating into jargon
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements from stakeholders who cannot hand over a specification, and to reach a working solution regardless
  • Ability to troubleshoot agent workflows built on platforms such as Claude, GPT-class models, LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI, and to isolate whether a failure originates in the prompt, the tool, the data, or the orchestration
  • Working proficiency with APIs and sufficient scripting ability to build and debug workflows independently; software engineering experience is not required, but a JSON payload or a Python script must not be a blocker
  • Sound judgment about model output, including the discipline to state plainly when an output should not be trusted
  • Strong written communication. This role produces documentation, runbooks, and reports that program leads and executives rely on
  • Hands-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or Cloudflare) and working familiarity with a second
  • Practical experience managing infrastructure as code using Terraform, Pulumi, or an equivalent
  • Working command of cloud networking, identity, and secrets management, and the ability to treat security posture and run cost as design constraints rather than afterthoughts

Desired Qualifications

Strong candidates will bring depth in one or more of the following. Do not screen yourself out for lacking items on this list.

  • 5-7 years experience in software development
  • Experience coding using Python
  • Cloud depth: Kubernetes or serverless runtimes at production scale; multi-cloud or cross-boundary deployment; cloud migration or consolidation work
  • Cost and governance: FinOps or formal cloud cost management practice; zero-trust architectures; federated access control models
  • Delivery and observability: owning CI/CD pipelines end to end; infrastructure monitoring, logging, and alerting for production workloads
  • Bridging technical and operational teams: prior work as a solutions consultant, technical program manager, forward-deployed engineer, or in a product-adjacent role
  • AI reliability practice: monitoring, evaluation, or observability tooling for AI systems in production; automated evaluations or regression checks for LLM-based workflows; human-in-the-loop review steps that maintain quality without creating bottlenecks
  • Process design: designing SOPs or escalation frameworks that hold up across multiple stakeholders
  • AI-assisted development tooling: working fluency with Claude, Copilot, or Cursor
  • Mission environment: operating within or supporting a government or defense program; OSINT, DIGINT, or intelligence analysis workflows and tradecraft; data governance concepts, federated access control models, or zero-trust architectures
  • Operating range: a track record of coming up to speed quickly on unfamiliar systems, and effectiveness in a distributed, multi-program environment with competing priorities

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
  • Travel: Occasional (up to 10%) to McLean, VA or team offsites as needed

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Senior IT Systems Engineer

As a Senior IT Engineer, you help shape and improve the systems that our 250+ person remote company relies on every day. Your work spans identity and access, Google Workspace, device management, and our wider SaaS environment.
Reporting to the IT Director, you take ownership of complex problems and lead improvements from initial assessment through delivery. You identify what needs attention, recommend priorities, and make thoughtful decisions that balance security, reliability, and employee experience. You also help the team build stronger practices through clear documentation, shared knowledge, and practical guidance.

What to expect

  • Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward.

  • Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs.

  • Device management: Help lead the rollout and ongoing development of JumpCloud and our device management practices across macOS, Windows, and Linux. Define and implement device configurations, security policies, software deployment, and onboarding processes in partnership with IT Operations and Security.

  • Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

  • Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

  • SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

  • Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

  • Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

What you bring

  • Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

  • Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

  • Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

  • Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

  • A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

  • Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

  • Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

  • Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

  • Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

Bonus points

  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including assessing and integrating identity systems, Google Workspace environments, devices, or SaaS tools.

  • Experience in a developer-heavy or engineering-led company.

  • Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

  • Professional proficiency in French.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, IT)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (Senior Director, Site Reliability Engineering, Senior IT Manager)
  4. 45 Minutes with Executive (Senior Director, FP&A & IT)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🧠 Professional development budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. title: Senior Product Content Manager

raw.title: Senior Product Content Manager
raw.excerpt: Taking part in a clinical trial can ask a lot of people, especially as trials become more complex.
raw.description:
Taking part in a clinical trial can ask a lot of people, especially as trials become more complex. At Little Journey, we’re building Trial Flow, a participant support platform that makes that experience simpler, clearer and more supportive, helping participants and caregivers around the world feel prepared for what comes next. We work collaboratively, challenge our thinking and value people who can turn ideas into action. The Senior Product Content Manager will play a key role in ensuring our content supports the growth of the platform.

The Role

Content is a critical part of the Trial Flow experience. It helps participants understand what to expect, complete key actions and engage confidently throughout their clinical trial journey. Our content spans written, audio, video and product UI experiences for children, teenagers, caregivers and adult participants around the world.

In your role, you will lead our approach to content across the product, developing the strategy, standards and guardrails that enable us to deliver high-quality, effective content at scale, on time and on budget. You will work closely with Product, Delivery, Clinical, Design and other teams to align content priorities and approaches with participant needs, product goals and business priorities.

You will be accountable for the effectiveness of our end-to-end content capability, from how content is designed and generated through to clinical review, publishing and localisation. You will line manage the Content Co-ordination Manager and Localisation Manager, oversee the outputs of freelancers and other contributors, and work with internal subject matter experts to ensure content is accurate and effective.

This role is right for someone who enjoys setting direction and creating effective ways of working, but is equally comfortable getting stuck in when needed. You might experiment with AI prompts and workflows, shape product UI content, improve a process or tackle a complex content challenge yourself.

If you are looking for a primarily editorial or copywriting role where most of your time is spent creating content yourself or your background is primarily in Marketing content roles, this is unlikely to be the right role for you.

The role reports to the CPO and sits within the Product team. You will need to be hands on, and work closely with your direct reports in a small team.

This is a full-time role, either hybrid in Leeds or fully remote within the UK. We cannot sponsor visas to work in the UK.

Responsibilities

Content strategy and content experience

  • Develop and evolve our content strategy in collaboration with Product, Clinical, Discovery, Design, Commercial and other stakeholders, aligning participant needs, product strategy and business priorities.
  • Drive a commercially sustainable approach to content, maximising reuse and efficient adaptation while ensuring costs and margins inform pricing decisions.
  • Refine the principles, guidelines and guardrails to enable consistent, high-quality content decisions.
  • Evolve the content experience across Little Journey and Trial Flow, including educational, support, coping and product UI content.
  • Identify opportunities for content to improve participant outcomes, product engagement and customer value, working with Product and Design to incorporate these into product discovery and development.
  • Develop how we use AI alongside human expertise to generate and iterate high-quality content, experimenting with prompts, models and workflows while putting appropriate guardrails and clinical validation in place.

Content quality and delivery

  • Own Content Delivery, working closely with Delivery to ensure content is delivered on time, on budget and to our quality benchmarks.
  • Establish and maintain proportionate standards, governance and approval processes that ensure content is accurate, appropriate and consistent without creating unnecessary barriers to delivery.
  • Manage complex content lifecycles, ensuring content moves effectively from identified need through generation, expert review, publishing, delivery, versioning, and archival .
  • Provide content judgement where participant, clinical, product or commercial requirements need to be balanced.
  • Continuously improve how content is structured and delivered, using better processes, tooling, automation and reuse to increase efficiency and scalability.

Localisation

  • Be accountable for the effectiveness of our localisation capability and strategy, ensuring it delivers the required quality, scalability and cost-effectiveness as Little Journey grows internationally.
  • Set clear outcomes and priorities for localisation and support the Localisation Manager to deliver them.

Influencing and Collaboration

  • Line manage and develop your team, setting clear outcomes and enabling them to take ownership of delivery.
  • Work directly with client stakeholders where needed to align content plans, manage feedback and resolve content-related issues.
  • Commission and oversee freelancers and external contributors, ensuring clear briefs, expectations and quality of outputs.
  • Work closely with key internal stakeholders to create alignment around content priorities and decisions, ensuring content is championed across roadmaps, projects, engagements and company priorities.

Measurement and continuous improvement

  • Define appropriate measures of content effectiveness and operational metrics within Little Journey's existing data framework, connecting content performance to relevant company and product metrics.
  • Use participant feedback, product and behavioural data, operational insights and stakeholder input to identify and prioritise improvements.
  • Measure whether changes to content, localisation, tooling and ways of working are improving outcomes, quality, efficiency or cost.

Requirements

Required:

  • Significant and demonstrable experience developing and implementing content strategy for digital products or platforms.
  • Experience establishing content governance, standards and scalable content processes within the product function.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Design and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality content.
  • Practical experience using generative AI to create or iterate content, with the curiosity and confidence to experiment with prompts, models and workflows while applying appropriate quality controls.
  • Strong understanding of content lifecycle management.
  • Experience using user insights and data to improve content effectiveness.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and organisational skills.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience leading work through others, including setting direction, giving high-quality feedback and holding internal or external contributors accountable for outcomes.
  • Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive content principles.

Desirable:

  • Experience managing multilingual content and localisation.
  • Experience in clinical trials or another regulated industry.
  • Financial understanding of content creation or previous P&L or cost ownership
  • Experience with UX writing or information architecture.
  • Experience managing or configuring a Content Management System.
  • Experience designing content across broad age groups.
  • Understanding of behaviour change, patient education or health literacy principles.

Benefits

  • 28 days annual leave per year (plus public holidays)
  • £500 annual training budget  
  • £200 home working budget (one-off) 
  • Up to 6% pension match (salary sacrifice) 
  • EMI share options
  • Enhanced (family & parental) leave policies  

About Little Journey 

Little Journey was founded by Dr Chris Evans, a paediatric anaesthetist and researcher, and Sophie Copley, a human-centred product designer, with a shared ambition to improve how people are supported through complex experiences. What began by supporting children and families through healthcare has evolved into Trial Flow, our platform focused entirely on participant support in clinical trials.

Our mission is to make patient-centric participation the foundation of better research. We believe better support leads to better participation, and better participation leads to better research. As clinical trials become more complex, Trial Flow helps participants, families and sites navigate what is being asked of them, reducing avoidable burden and supporting better adherence, retention and trial outcomes.

Today, Little Journey is a Series A company with a team of around 30 to 40 people, working with pharmaceutical companies on clinical trials around the world. We care deeply about the people our work ultimately supports, and that shapes how we work together. We value honesty and integrity, trust people to take accountability, and make time to reflect, learn and improve.

Diversity & Inclusion 

We encourage people from all walks of life to apply and strive to eliminate unconscious bias in our recruitment process. We do not discriminate on ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or parental status or disability. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. If you need adjustments made to our application process, to help accommodate any disabilities, please let us know on

Devenez chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire

Accédez à des missions rémunérées de convoyage de véhicules partout en France, avec une organisation flexible et des frais de route pris en charge.

👉 Inscrivez-vous ici pour accéder aux missions :

DriiveMe est la plateforme leader européen du convoyage de véhicules. Chaque mois, plus de 20 000 missions rémunérées sont proposées à notre communauté de chauffeurs et convoyeurs indépendants partout en France.

Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar, et bien d’autres.

Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.

En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

  1. Vous créez votre compte sur

  2. Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

  3. Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

  4. Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

  5. Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

  6. Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Pourquoi devenir chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire ?

  • Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

  • Organisation flexible : vous choisissez librement les missions que vous souhaitez effectuer.

  • Frais de route pris en charge : carburant et péages sont remboursés selon les conditions de la mission.

  • Plateforme simple et intuitive : consultation, réservation et suivi des missions en ligne.

  • Missions partout en France : de nouvelles opportunités sont publiées chaque jour.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?

Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.

Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.

Avant de réserver une mission, vous connaissez les informations essentielles : lieu de départ, lieu d’arrivée, rémunération et conditions de prise en charge. Vous êtes libre de réserver uniquement les missions qui vous conviennent.

Profil recherché

Pour rejoindre DriiveMe Partenaire, vous devez idéalement :

  • disposer d’un permis B valide ;

  • être indépendant ou prêt à le devenir ;

  • être sérieux, ponctuel et rigoureux ;

  • respecter les procédures de prise en charge et de livraison des véhicules ;

  • être disponible pour réaliser des missions ponctuelles dans votre région ou ailleurs en France.

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Fullstack Engineer, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 2-3 years of experience, hands-on Contentful expertise, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Strong on React, TypeScript and Next.js

Role responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable Contentful content models that work well for editors and developers
  • Build and consume Contentful delivery APIs (Content Delivery, Preview, GraphQL) to power web experiences
  • Develop front-end features using TypeScript, React and Next.js
  • Design and build integrations and APIs (including CRUD operations) between Contentful and other client systems
  • Collaborate with designers, architects and client teams in an agile environment
  • Take part in story refinement, estimation and code reviews
  • Write clean, tested and well-documented code, with attention to performance, accessibility and security

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 2-3 years of hands-on experience as a full-stack engineer
  • Hands-on experience with Contentful, including content modeling
  • Strong experience with React, TypeScript and Next.js
  • Experience building and consuming APIs (REST/GraphQL), including CRUD integrations between systems
  • Experience working in agile teams and collaborating with designers, architects and clients
  • Experience writing clean, tested and well-documented code

Nice to have qualifications

  • CMS migrations (content mapping, transformation and validation)
  • AI and automation tooling to improve content workflows and developer productivity
  • Contentful webhooks, apps/extensions or the Management API

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

Pay rate: $19.38–$24.23 per hour. This pay rate may be lower than your state’s minimum wage, so please take this into consideration before applying.

Schedule: An eight-hour shift between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time.

About the Role

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Pension Benefits Administrator to help ensure client satisfaction and operational excellence. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working across multiple systems, and experienced with Microsoft Excel. Experience with SQL or database queries is a plus.

As a Pension Benefits Administrator, you will work collaboratively with a team to research and respond to pension plan questions, resolve participant issues, review benefit reports, and support accurate and timely benefit administration. You will have a direct impact on the quality of the services and information provided to participants, beneficiaries, clients, and third parties.

This position offers an opportunity to develop pension administration expertise, learn new processes, and contribute to projects while working in a remote environment.

Responsibilities

  • Triage, research, and respond to participant issues involving eligibility, benefit calculations, plan provisions, tax inquiries, and electronic funds transfer (EFT) questions.
  • Review benefit reports, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), and take appropriate action as needed.
  • Complete payment setups for pension annuities and lump-sum payments under the direction of a senior team member.
  • Perform complex and non-complex research and data analysis to resolve inquiries from participants, clients, and third parties, providing supporting documentation and detailed explanations.
  • Acquire, review, and communicate relevant information and documentation to be shared with plan participants and beneficiaries.
  • Respond to customer inquiries, pension verification requests, and form reprint requests.
  • Research and resolve issues involving records with missing or incomplete data.
  • Work with banking vendors to assist with participant questions and service requests.
  • Use PASS and other applicable systems to complete assigned pension administration activities.
  • Run queries and reports to retrieve, review, and analyze information.
  • Contribute to projects and additional assignments with guidance from senior team members.
  • Collaborate with colleagues and leadership to resolve unusual or complex issues.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable legal and regulatory changes, industry trends, and developments affecting retirement benefits, plan requirements, and Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs).
  • Perform other duties as assigned while complying with all applicable policies, procedures, and quality standards.

Requirements

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must be able to pass a criminal background check.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to navigate and work across multiple computer systems and applications.
  • Basic Microsoft Office proficiency, including Excel.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks, follow established procedures, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.
  • Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and responsibilities.
  • Must pass an internet speed test with download speeds equal to or greater than 25 Mbps, upload speeds equal to or greater than 5 Mbps, and ping equal to or less than 175 ms.
  • Must have the ability to connect to a modem or router using an Ethernet cable.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Excel beyond basic functions.
  • Familiarity with SQL, database queries, or reporting tools.
  • Experience with pension administration, retirement benefits, financial services, or benefits processing.
  • Experience researching customer inquiries, reviewing reports, or analyzing data.
  • Knowledge of pension plan provisions, benefit calculations, or retirement plan documentation.

Training and Development

Training and support will be provided to help you learn the responsibilities of the role. Initial training for certain tasks is expected to take approximately one month, with additional training as new responsibilities are introduced.

The ideal candidate is eager to learn, comfortable adapting to changing business needs, and committed to producing accurate, high-quality work.

Remote Work and Hiring Locations

This is a remote, work-from-home position. Applicants must have a reliable internet connection that meets the required speed test standards and the ability to connect to a modem or router using an Ethernet cable.

We are currently not hiring in the following geographies, including but not limited to:

States: Alaska (AK), California (CA), Hawaii (HI), Massachusetts (MA), Illinois (IL), Montana (MT), and New York (NY).

Metro areas: Minneapolis, MN; Chicago, IL; New York City, NY; Portland, OR; Montgomery County, MD; Seattle, WA; and Washington, DC.

Due to varying state and local minimum wage laws, we are currently only able to hire candidates residing in states where our compensation structure complies with applicable wage regulations. As a result, we may be unable to consider applicants from certain states or municipalities at this time.

Pay Transparency and Benefits

Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated annual salary range for this role is $40,320–$50,400.
