raw.description:
Summary

The Cybersecurity Professional Services Leader is responsible for the people, delivery execution, operational performance, and continued development of Logicalis US cybersecurity professional services. This leader ensures that cybersecurity engagements are staffed appropriately, delivered consistently, and completed in alignment with customer outcomes, contractual commitments, quality expectations, schedule, and financial objectives. This leader will play a key role in building and scaling Logicalis’ cybersecurity professional services capabilities through workforce development, delivery standardization, operational excellence, and repeatable service delivery models.

The role leads cybersecurity professional services resources delivering advisory, assessment, architecture, implementation, migration, remediation, and incident-readiness engagements across the Logicalis cybersecurity portfolio. The leader works closely with the Cybersecurity Practice, Portfolio Management, Sales, Solution Architects, Project Management, Managed Services, Operations, and strategic delivery partners to translate market-ready offerings into repeatable, scalable, and high-quality customer delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Cybersecurity Delivery Leadership

· Owns delivery execution across the cybersecurity professional services portfolio, including Advisory and GRC, AI security and governance, data protection, exposure management, security operations, cyber resilience, and identity and zero trust services.

· Ensures engagements are executed in accordance with approved Statements of Work, delivery methodologies, customer expectations, and internal quality standards.

· Provides leadership oversight for complex or high-risk engagements and serve as an escalation point for delivery, customer, resource, scope, schedule, or quality concerns.

· Establishes consistent delivery practices, standards, templates, quality checkpoints, and lessons-learned processes across cybersecurity engagements.

· Ensures effective transition from sales and solution development into delivery, including scope validation, resource readiness, delivery assumptions, acceptance criteria, and customer kickoff preparation.

· Partners with project management resources to monitor engagement health, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, change control, and customer communications.

  • undefined

· Ensures findings, recommendations, configurations, architectures, and other deliverables are clear, actionable, technically sound, and appropriate for the customer environment.


Resource and Talent Leadership

· Builds and matures cybersecurity delivery capabilities through strategic hiring, technical enablement, certification planning, mentoring, and succession planning.

· Leads, coaches, and develops cybersecurity consultants, engineers, architects, and other professional services resources.

· Owns workforce planning for cybersecurity professional services, balancing demand, skills, geography, utilization, customer needs, and employee development.

· Assigns the right resources to engagements based on technical capability, experience, availability, and engagement risk.

· Defines role expectations, technical skill requirements, certification priorities, and development roadmaps in partnership with Cybersecurity Practice leadership.

· Owns recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and retention of cybersecurity delivery talent.

· Builds a culture of accountability, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, customer focus, and cross-team collaboration.

· Develops an intentional sourcing model that determines when work should be delivered with internal resources, strategic partners, or subcontractors, while protecting quality, customer experience, and margin.


Operational and Financial Management

· Monitors and manages utilization, backlog coverage, capacity, project margin, revenue forecasting, time entry, delivery efficiency, and other professional services operating metrics.

· Provides accurate and timely reporting on resource demand, staffing gaps, engagement health, delivery risks, and financial performance.

· Identifies operational constraints and implement improvements that increase delivery quality, scalability, predictability, and profitability.

· Ensures appropriate governance for subcontractor and partner delivery, including resource qualification, onboarding, statements of work, performance oversight, and quality assurance.

· Partners with Operations and Finance to support forecasting, resource planning, cost management, and corrective actions when performance is outside expectations.


Portfolio Readiness and Continuous Improvement

· Partners with the Cybersecurity Practice Director and Portfolio Management to ensure new and updated offerings are executable before release to the field.

· Provides delivery input into service design, scope boundaries, level-of-effort assumptions, skills requirements, dependencies, pricing considerations, and delivery risk.

· Converts lessons learned from customer engagements into improvements to methods, templates, enablement, estimates, and solution definitions.

· Maintains awareness of evolving cybersecurity threats, technologies, frameworks, partner capabilities, and customer requirements that may affect delivery readiness.

· Translates new cybersecurity offerings into repeatable delivery motions by defining delivery methodologies, resource requirements, quality standards, and implementation approaches.

· Helps standardize repeatable delivery motions while preserving the flexibility required for complex customer environments.


Customer, Sales, and Cross-Functional Engagement

· Builds trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and participate in executive-level engagement reviews when needed.

· Partners with Sales and Solution Architects during strategic or complex opportunities to validate delivery approach, resource availability, assumptions, sequencing, and risk.

· Supports development and review of proposals, Statements of Work, change requests, and delivery plans.

· Identifies follow-on needs and transition qualified opportunities to Sales without compromising the objectivity or quality of delivery.

· Coordinates with Managed Services to create effective transitions from project delivery into ongoing operations, governance, or lifecycle services.

· Collaborates across technology practices when cybersecurity outcomes depend on cloud, network, modern workplace, data center, data governance, or other capabilities.

General

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.
  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Directly leads assigned cybersecurity professional services employees and may oversee partner or subcontractor resources engaged in customer delivery. Responsibilities may include workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, work assignment, coaching, development planning, performance management, recognition, and resolution of employee or delivery concerns in accordance with company policies and applicable law.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual should be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications

Equivalent combination accepted.

Education:

· Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Experience / Technical Requirements

· 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology consulting, professional services, systems integration, or related delivery roles.

· 3+ years of experience leading technical consulting or professional services resources.

  • undefined

· Broad working knowledge across cybersecurity domains such as governance, risk and compliance; security assessments; data protection; identity and access management; zero trust; vulnerability and exposure management; SIEM, XDR, EDR, and firewalls; incident readiness and response; and security architecture.

· Ability to understand cybersecurity risk, translate technical issues into business impact, and communicate clearly with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders.

· Familiarity with common cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and other customer-relevant regulatory or industry requirements.

· Ability to evaluate technical delivery risk and recognize when deeper subject-matter expertise is required.

Certifications

· Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, PMP, or comparable technical or delivery credentials.

Other Skills and Abilities

· Experience building, scaling, or transforming a cybersecurity consulting, professional services, or technical delivery organization.

· Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple concurrent customer engagements with accountability for staffing, quality, schedule, scope, risk, and financial performance.

· Experience developing technical talent and managing geographically distributed teams.

· Experience working across sales, presales, project management, delivery, operations, portfolio, and managed services functions.

· Working knowledge of Statements of Work, change control, project financials, utilization, capacity planning, and services margin.

  • undefined

· Experience in a systems integrator, consulting firm, managed services provider, or cybersecurity services organization.

· Experience working with strategic cybersecurity technology partners and partner-enabled delivery models.

· Experience integrating professional services with managed security services or ongoing operational support.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that should be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

Logicalis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to employ people who are qualified by reason of education, training, experience, and demonstrated performance. We value inclusion and belonging at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.

NOTE:It is Logicalis’ practice that when a client requires medical testing, the employee must accept that requirement as a condition of their assignment and either submit to the tests or show proof they’ve completed the test satisfactorily (i.e., TB Test negative).

Salary Range: $160,000 - $175,000 + Bonus

We offer a full range of service on claims of all sizes including the provision of advice, preparation of Bills of Costs, drafting Points of Dispute and Replies, preparing Costs Budgets and dealing with all aspects of the cost budgeting process to include attendance at CCMCs, drafting skeleton arguments on technical challenges, negotiating settlements, attending Detailed Assessment hearings and dealing with part 8 cost procedures.

We have hubs in Birmingham, Leicester, London, Milton Keynes, Nottingham, Solihull, Stratford-upon-Avon and Sheffield.

  • Drafting schedules of costs

  • Strong numerical ability
  • Experience in drafting bills of costs (Claimant role)

raw.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities specialization is required. Advanced degrees are strongly preferred (Master’s or PhD)
  • Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English and Turkish

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $15-$20 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s guide at

raw.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you.

What you’ll do in the role:

  • Deliver AI observability capabilities end to end, from ingestion to in-product visualizations.
  • Contribute to the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product.
  • Build systems that analyze and surface AI-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies.
  • Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows.
  • Share what you learn about exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads.
  • Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Experience shipping customer-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling.
  • Full-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React).
  • A track record of working with product managers and designers.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day engineering work.
  • Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days.
  • A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job.
  • Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent-powered features in production.
  • Bonus: Hands-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$218,891—$245,946 CAD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. raw.excerpt: About Sunrise GroupSunrise Group is building the future of sleep health by combining breakthrough technology with expert care.
raw.description:
About Sunrise Group

Sunrise Group is building the future of sleep health by combining breakthrough technology with expert care. We started in 2015 with a straightforward idea: sleep diagnosis should happen in the comfort of your own home, not in a hospital. To make that possible, we created a first-of-its-kind chin sensor, carefully validated through clinical research, reviewed by leading sleep experts, and cleared by the FDA.

Since then, Sunrise Group has grown from a single innovation into a complete sleep health company. We now design advanced diagnostic and treatment solutions, and we deliver care directly to patients through Dreem Health, our digital sleep clinic. By serving patients in all 50 states with reimbursed care, we are making sleep treatment more accessible, more personal, and much simpler than it has ever been.

Sunrise (Dreem Health) is a ~170-person digital health company building the best online sleep clinic. We help patients get diagnosed and treated for sleep apnea entirely from home: a medically certified at-home sleep test, teleconsultations with sleep physicians, and physician-supervised treatment and follow-up. Our engineering team builds the products that make this possible, from patient-facing web apps to the clinical tools our care teams use every day.

You will join at a moment where the engineering organization is scaling and needs a second Engineering Manager. You will lead 6 to 10 engineers across 2 to 3 product squads, reporting directly to the CTO. You own your squads: the people, the staffing, and the delivery, and you share product outcomes with your Product counterparts. Each squad has a Tech Lead who owns technical feasibility and task breakdown, supported by a transverse Principal Engineer. You are a technical manager: you stay close enough to the code and the designs to ask the right questions, push great engineering, and help your squads keep raising the bar.

What you will do :

  • Lead and develop a team of 6 to 10 engineers across 2 to 3 product squads. Run 1:1s, give honest feedback, own performance and promotion decisions, and build development plans against our engineering ladder
  • Own delivery for your squads: what gets committed, who works on what, and whether it lands. Challenge scope and dates with Product, with an explicit mandate to refuse commitments the team cannot sustainably meet
  • Protect long-term velocity: own the capacity allocation for tech health and platform quality
  • Hire: partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close engineers. Run technical interviews yourself and hold the hiring bar.
  • Raise the technical bar: stay close to the code and designs where it matters most (high-risk changes, new patterns, design docs, review quality), using AI tooling to navigate the codebase efficiently, and help your squads turn good engineering into great engineering.
  • Work closely with Tech Leads and the Principal Engineer, who own technical feasibility and task breakdown in their scope. Challenge them on ambition and approach, unblock them, and escalate structural risks early
  • Champion modern, AI-augmented engineering practices and continuous improvement of how the team works
  • Stay deeply immersed in product and business context: direct stakeholder relationships, presence in squad rituals, and manage cross-squad dependencies

What you will bring :

  • At least 3 years managing software engineers in a dedicated management role
  • 5+ years as a software engineer before moving into management, including senior-level ownership of production systems
  • Track record of shipping and operating production web products, with enough technical depth to challenge designs and estimates credibly (our stack: React, Django, GCP)
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Design in an empowered-squad model
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted engineering tooling, and opinionated about where it helps and where it does not
  • Fluent English (working language); French is a plus
  • Genuine interest in sleep, health, and helping people better understand and improve their well-being

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

About the Role

Our products move fast. Our field has to move faster.

As Senior Director, Global Enablement, you'll lead the function that gets every Abnormal seller, engineer, customer success leader, and channel partner ready to win, and keeps them ready as our platform grows. Reporting to Ted Noble, VP of GTM Operations, you'll lead a team of enablement directors, managers, and their teams across field enablement, technical enablement, onboarding, certifications, and partner enablement. You'll own the programs people remember, from our in-person onboarding bootcamps to field enablement events, and you'll build the system behind them: an AI-first, just-in-time enablement engine with feedback loops that turn what's happening in the field into what we teach next. This is a role for someone who wants to help make Abnormal the #1 AI-native company and who cares about helping people get better at their craft.

Enablement is a core growth driver at Abnormal. We closed FY26 at roughly $380M in ARR, growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. Our next chapter is the transition from email security to the Abnormal Behavioral AI platform, with multiple products across email, identity, and AI security. That shift only turns into growth if every seller, engineer, and partner can tell the platform story, sell multiple products into the same account, and support customers as they expand. We're also launching new products faster than traditional, quarterly training cycles can keep up with. You'll make enablement the engine that turns our platform strategy into pipeline, multi-product deals, and expansion.

What You Will Do

  • Make enablement a core growth driver. Position enablement as a strategic lever for the company's growth plan, directly tied to the shift to the Abnormal Behavioral AI platform. Build the programs that help the field move from single-product deals to platform and multi-product selling, and land, expand, and retain customers across the portfolio.
  • Lead a global, unified enablement organization. Set the strategy and operating model for field, technical, customer success, and partner enablement, and lead a multi-team organization of directors and managers, developing them into the next generation of enablement leaders and building succession across the function.
  • Build role-based programs for every field role. Design learning paths, programs, and skill development for AEs, SDRs, Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Professional Services, sales leaders, and Channel partners, each tuned to what that role needs to succeed.
  • Own role-based certifications. Define the standards that show someone is ready, from first-meeting readiness to product and technical mastery, and hold a high bar for certification quality, not just completion.
  • Run world-class onboarding and bootcamps. Own our in-person onboarding bootcamps and new hire programs so every GTM hire ramps quickly and arrives in front of customers prepared.
  • Own in-person field enablement. Plan and deliver high-impact live programs, including regional workshops, launch events, and enablement moments at company kickoffs, that build skills and energy across the field.
  • Lead technical enablement. Build product and technical depth across the GTM organization, aligned to our product portfolio, so every role understands what each product does, how the products work together as a platform, and how to position them against competitors.
  • Build partner and channel enablement. Create a scalable partner enablement program, including onboarding, certifications, and technical readiness, so partners can sell and deliver Abnormal with less reliance on our field teams.
  • Build an AI-first, just-in-time enablement engine. Design the system that gets the right answer, asset, or practice to the right person at the moment they need it, using AI role play, AI coaching, in-workflow guidance, and automated reinforcement. Set the standard that AI scales enablement without sacrificing accuracy or depth.
  • Keep pace with product velocity. Partner with Product and Product Marketing on a repeatable launch-readiness process with clear inputs, timelines, and readiness gates, so the field is certified and confident at launch.
  • Create continuous feedback loops. Use call insights, deal outcomes, certification data, and field feedback to find skill gaps early and adjust programs continuously.
  • Measure what matters. Track enablement impact on ramp time, certification quality, field confidence, behavior change, multi-product attach, and pipeline and revenue outcomes, and report it clearly to GTM and executive leadership.
  • Plan and allocate resources across teams. Own prioritization, intake, capacity planning, and budget across the enablement organization, including the enablement tech stack.
  • Be a strategic partner across GTM. Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, Product, Product Marketing, and Revenue Operations leadership to align enablement with company priorities.

Must Haves

  • 12+ years of experience in sales, technical, or GTM enablement at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, with at least 6 years leading teams, including leading multiple managers or directors across a global organization spanning North America, EMEA, and APJ.
  • Proven track record building and scaling enablement for multiple field roles, including AEs, SDRs, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success.
  • Experience enabling a GTM organization through a transition from a single product to a multi-product platform, with measurable impact on growth.
  • Experience designing and running role-based certification programs and in-person onboarding bootcamps at scale.
  • Experience building or scaling partner and channel enablement programs.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI to enablement, such as AI role play, AI coaching, or just-in-time, in-workflow learning, with sound judgment about where AI helps and where human coaching matters most.
  • Track record running product launch readiness in a fast-moving, multi-product environment.
  • Strong command of enablement measurement, with experience tying programs to ramp, productivity, and revenue outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, with the presence to lead a room of sellers and the credibility to influence executive and senior GTM leaders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with tools in our ecosystem, such as Highspot, Gong, Glean, Articulate Rise, and Synthesia.
  • Background in cybersecurity or another technical, enterprise-focused category.
  • Experience consolidating or migrating an enablement tech stack, including LMS platforms.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Senior Data Engineer

Remote · LATAM · Full-Time Contract

LATAM (Remote) Full-Time Contract ASAP English Required

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in AWS, batch processing, and real-time streaming architectures. This is a hands-on

role — you will design and own scalable data pipelines serving both high-throughput batch workloads (GBs to TBs) and low-latency streaming

systems. You will collaborate with analysts, data scientists, and business teams, and help mentor junior engineers to raise the bar across the data

platform.

Batch Processing

Design & implement batch pipelines for large-scale processing (GBs to

TBs)

Build ETL/ELT workflows using PySpark, SQL, Glue, and EMR

Optimize jobs for performance, partitioning, and cost

Manage data ingestion from DBs, files, and APIs into the data lake

Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability

Real-Time / Streaming

Design & implement real-time pipelines using Apache Flink (Scala

preferred)

Process high-throughput streams with low-latency requirements

Implement stateful processing, windowing, and event-time handling

Handle late/out-of-order events; exactly-once / at-least-once semantics

Configure checkpointing, fault tolerance, and recovery

Integrate with Kafka or Kinesis

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Build and maintain data lake / lakehouse architectures on AWS

(S3-based)

Integrate multiple data sources — APIs, SaaS platforms, databases

Ensure data governance, security, and access control (IAM)

Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for all pipelines

Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, and business teams

Mentor junior engineers and enforce best practices

TECH STACK

Python SQL Scala PySpark Apache Flink Apache Kafka AWS Glue Amazon EMR Amazon S3 AWS Lambda

Amazon Athena Amazon Kinesis Delta Lake / Iceberg

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of experience in Data Engineering

Strong skills in Python, SQL, and Scala

Hands-on AWS experience: S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, EMR,

Kinesis, IAM

Strong batch processing experience with Spark / PySpark at scale

Proven real-time streaming experience with Apache Flink in

production

Solid understanding of batch vs streaming trade-offs and event-driven

architectures

Experience building data lakes or data warehouses in production

Experience integrating external systems via APIs

Distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, partitioning,

consistency

WHAT MAKES A STRONG CANDIDATE

Has built both batch AND real-time pipelines in production — not just one or the other

Knows when to apply each paradigm: batch for cost-efficient large volumes, streaming for low-latency real-time use cases

Experience handling millions of records in batch and high event throughput in streaming systems

Strong debugging and performance optimization skills across distributed data systems

Hands-on mindset — you build things and own them end-to-end, not just design them

NICE TO HAVE

AWS certifications (Data Analytics Specialty, Solutions Architect)

Experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or open table formats

Familiarity with dbt for transformation workflows

Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow, AWS Step

Functions)

Background in IoT, telemetry, or event-heavy domains

OpenTelemetry or advanced observability experience

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You have only worked with batch OR only with streaming — this role requires both

You need a fully defined architecture and runbook before making engineering decisions

You are not comfortable owning pipelines end-to-end in production without daily oversight

You optimize for theoretical elegance before proving a real cost or reliability problem exists

You are not comfortable communicating directly in English with international teams

WHY COMMITTED STAFF

Committed Staff connects the top 1% of LATAM talent with high-growth U.S. companies. We don't just place candidates — we build committed teams

that scale. You'll get direct access to a real data engineering challenge with meaningful scope, full-time remote work aligned with U.S. time zones,

competitive LATAM-market compensation, and a growing network of senior tech professionals across Latin America.

About the Role

We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality.
